+"""Generic skeleton indexes and lexical retrieval."""
+import re, math, json, gzip, collections, warnings
+
+
+def load_json(path):
+    with (gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8") if path.endswith(".gz") else open(path, encoding="utf-8")) as fh:
+        return json.load(fh)
+
+
+def path_segs(p):
+    return [s for s in re.split(r"[/]+", p.split("?")[0]) if s]
+
+
+def match(req, tpl):
+    """Сегменты запроса против шаблона Spring: {x} — один сегмент, ** — хвост."""
+    if not tpl:
+        return not req
+    t = tpl[0]
+    if t == "**":
+        return True
+    if not req:
+        return False
+    if t.startswith("{") or t == "*" or t == req[0]:
+        return match(req[1:], tpl[1:])
+    return False
+
+
+def path_priority(template):
+    """Spring MVC specificity for the supported segment-pattern subset."""
+    variables = sum(part.startswith('{') for part in template)
+    wildcards = sum(part == '*' for part in template)
+    catchalls = sum(part == '**' or part.startswith('{*') for part in template)
+    length = sum(1 if part.startswith('{') else len(part) for part in template) + len(template)
+    return (-bool(catchalls), -variables - wildcards - 2 * catchalls, length, variables - wildcards)
+
+
+_SPRING_MAPPINGS = {"RequestMapping": None, "GetMapping": "GET", "PostMapping": "POST",
+                    "PutMapping": "PUT", "PatchMapping": "PATCH", "DeleteMapping": "DELETE"}
+
+
+class RouteWarning(UserWarning):
+    """Маршрут аннотации не удалось разобрать: путь не литерал."""
+
+
+def _split_args(s):
+    """Аргументы аннотации: деление по запятым верхнего уровня вне кавычек и скобок."""
+    s = (s or "").strip()
+    if s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")"):
+        s = s[1:-1]
+    parts, buf, depth, q, esc = [], [], 0, "", False
+    for ch in s:
+        if q:
+            buf.append(ch)
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == q:
+                q = ""
+        elif ch in "\"'":
+            q = ch; buf.append(ch)
+        elif ch in "([{":
+            depth += 1; buf.append(ch)
+        elif ch in ")]}":
+            depth -= 1; buf.append(ch)
+        elif ch == "," and depth == 0:
+            parts.append("".join(buf).strip()); buf = []
+        else:
+            buf.append(ch)
+    if buf:
+        parts.append("".join(buf).strip())
+    return [p for p in parts if p]
+
+
+_LIT = r'"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"'
+_CONCAT = re.compile(r"\s*{0}(?:\s*\+\s*{0})*\s*".format(_LIT))
+_HTTP_METHODS = {"GET", "HEAD", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS", "TRACE"}
+
+
+def _literal(expr):
+    """Строковый литерал или чистая конкатенация литералов -> значение; иначе None."""
+    if not _CONCAT.fullmatch(expr):
+        return None
+    vals = []
+    for tok in re.findall(_LIT, expr):
+        try:
+            vals.append(json.loads(tok))
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return "".join(vals)
+
+
+def _path_values(expr, a):
+    """Пути value/path: литерал/массив литералов; пустой массив — [""], иначе None при неразрешимости."""
+    s = expr.strip()
+    if s.startswith("{") and s.endswith("}"):
+        comps = _split_args(s[1:-1])
+        if not comps:
+            return [""]
+        vals = []
+        for c in comps:
+            v = _literal(c)
+            if v is None:
+                warnings.warn("неразрешённый элемент пути в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], c), RouteWarning)
+            else:
+                vals.append(v)
+        return vals or None
+    v = _literal(s)
+    if v is None:
+        warnings.warn("не литеральный путь в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], expr), RouteWarning)
+    return [v] if v is not None else None
+
+
+def _method_verb(expr):
+    """RequestMethod.X (возможно полное имя) или стандартная константа -> HTTP-метод; иначе None."""
+    s = expr.strip()
+    m = re.fullmatch(r"(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\.\s*)*RequestMethod\s*\.\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)", s) or re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)", s)
+    return m.group(1) if m and m.group(1) in _HTTP_METHODS else None
+
+
+def _method_values(expr, a):
+    """Методы method=...: константа/массив; пустой массив — без ограничения, None — неразрешено."""
+    s = expr.strip()
+    if s.startswith("{") and s.endswith("}"):
+        comps = _split_args(s[1:-1])
+        if not comps:
+            return ["REQUEST"]
+        vals = []
+        for c in comps:
+            v = _method_verb(c)
+            if v is None:
+                warnings.warn("неразрешённый метод в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], c), RouteWarning)
+            else:
+                vals.append(v)
+        return vals or None
+    v = _method_verb(s)
+    if v is None:
+        warnings.warn("неразрешённый метод в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], expr), RouteWarning)
+        return None
+    return [v]
+
+
+def ann_paths(anns):
+    """Маршруты Spring: только value/path (литерал или массив); method=RequestMethod.X — по tuple на метод."""
+    out = []
+    for a in anns or []:
+        base = a["name"].rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
+        if base not in _SPRING_MAPPINGS:
+            continue
+        paths, verbs, bad = None, None, False
+        for i, part in enumerate(_split_args(a.get("args") or "")):
+            m = re.match(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(.*)$", part, re.S)
+            name, expr = (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else (None, part)
+            if name in ("value", "path") or (name is None and i == 0):
+                paths = _path_values(expr, a)
+                bad = bad or paths is None
+            elif name == "method":
+                verbs = _method_values(expr, a)
+                bad = bad or verbs is None
+        if bad:
+            continue
+        if paths is None:
+            paths = [""]
+        fixed = _SPRING_MAPPINGS[base]
+        if fixed:
+            verbs = [fixed]
+        elif verbs is None:
+            verbs = ["REQUEST"]
+        for v in verbs:
+            out.append((v, list(paths)))
+    return out
+
+
+def toks(t):
+    return [w.lower() for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z][a-z0-9]+|[A-Z]+(?![a-z])", re.sub(r"([a-z])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", t or "")) if len(w) > 2]
+
+
+class Index:
+    """Скелет: обработчики с шаблонами путей, рёбра для обхода, unit'ы модулей."""
+
+    def __init__(self, sk):
+        self.sk = sk; N = self.N = sk["nodes"]
+        self.handlers = []; seen = set()
+        for nid, n in N.items():
+            if n["kind"] != "method":
+                continue
+            mp = ann_paths(n.get("annotations"))
+            if not mp:
+                continue
+            owner_anns = N[n["owner"]].get("annotations") or []
+            cls_ann = ann_paths(owner_anns)
+            if not cls_ann and any(a["name"].rsplit(".", 1)[-1] in _SPRING_MAPPINGS for a in owner_anns):
+                continue
+            cls_paths = list(dict.fromkeys(p for _, ps in cls_ann for p in ps)) or [""]
+            cls_verbs = {v for v, _ in cls_ann if v and v != "REQUEST"}
+            for verb, vals in mp:
+                if verb == "REQUEST":
+                    verbs = sorted(cls_verbs) or [None]
+                elif cls_verbs:
+                    verbs = sorted(cls_verbs | {verb})
+                else:
+                    verbs = [verb]
+                for hv in verbs:
+                    for v in vals:
+                        for cp in cls_paths:
+                            segs = path_segs(cp + "/" + v); key = (nid, hv, tuple(segs))
+                            if key not in seen:
+                                seen.add(key); self.handlers.append((nid, hv, segs))
+        self.cs_method = {nid: n["method"] for nid, n in N.items() if n["kind"] == "call_site"}
+        self.calls = collections.defaultdict(set); self.over = collections.defaultdict(set)
+        self.wiring = collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(set))
+        for e in sk["edges"]:
+            if e["type"] == "calls":
+                self.calls[self.cs_method[e["source"]]].add(e["target"])
+            elif e["type"] == "overrides":
+                self.over[e["target"]].add(e["source"])
+            elif e["type"] in ("remote_call", "message_delivery", "runtime_dispatch", "data_access"):
+                self.wiring[e["type"]][self.cs_method.get(e["source"], e["source"])].add(e["target"])
+        self.module = {nid: n["module"] for nid, n in N.items() if n["kind"] == "method"}
+        self.units = {n["name"]: set(n.get("deployment_units") or [n["name"]]) for n in N.values() if n["kind"] == "module"}
+        self.size = collections.Counter(u for us in self.units.values() for u in us)
+        self.stmts = collections.defaultdict(list)
+        for e in sk["edges"]:
+            if e["type"] == "contains" and e["target"].startswith("stmt:"):
+                self.stmts[e["source"]].append(e["target"])
+
+    def unit_of(self, m):
+        """Самый узкий unit модуля метода: отдельный сервис при нескольких вариантах сборки."""
+        mod = self.module[m]
+        return min(self.units.get(mod, {mod}), key=lambda u: (self.size[u], u))
+
+    def cha(self, m):
+        out, st = set(), [m]
+        while st:
+            x = st.pop()
+            for o in self.over.get(x, ()):
+                if o not in out:
+                    out.add(o); st.append(o)
+        return out
+
+    def handlers_for(self, method, path, host=None):
+        """Обработчики, чей шаблон совпадает с путём запроса (host — сервис, если проект без gateway)."""
+        segs = path_segs(path); matches = []
+        for nid, verb, tpl in self.handlers:
+            if host and host not in self.N[nid]["module"]:
+                continue
+            if (verb is None or method is None or verb == method or (method == "HEAD" and verb == "GET")) and match(segs, tpl):
+                matches.append((nid, verb, tpl))
+        return self.preferred_handlers(matches, method)
+
+    def preferred_handlers(self, candidates, method=None):
+        """Compare paths within each service and known HTTP method."""
+        best, output = {}, collections.defaultdict(set)
+        for nid, verb, template in candidates:
+            group = (self.N[nid]['module'], verb if method is None else method)
+            priority = (*path_priority(template), bool(method and verb == method))
+            if group not in best or priority > best[group]:
+                best[group], output[group] = priority, {nid}
+            elif priority == best[group]:
+                output[group].add(nid)
+        return set().union(*output.values()) if output else set()
+
+    def handler_docs(self):
+        """Текст обработчика для лексического поиска: шаблон пути (x3), имя (x2), модуль."""
+        docs = {}
+        for nid, verb, tpl in self.handlers:
+            docs.setdefault(nid, []).extend(toks(" ".join(tpl)) * 3 + toks(self.N[nid]["name"]) * 2 + toks(self.N[nid]["module"]))
+        return docs
+
+    def closure(self, entries):
+        """Обход в контексте unit'а: вызовы — только в модули того же unit'а (общие модули могут входить в несколько сервисов);
+        remote — переход в unit обработчика. -> (методы, calls, remote, data)."""
+        seen, edges, remote, data = set(), set(), set(), set()
+        st = [(m, self.unit_of(m)) for m in entries]
+        while st:
+            m, u = st.pop()
+            if (m, u) in seen:
+                continue
+            seen.add((m, u))
+            for t in self.calls.get(m, ()):
+                for x in ({t} | self.cha(t) | self.wiring["runtime_dispatch"].get(m, set())):
+                    if not self.N[x].get("abstract") and u in self.units.get(self.module.get(x), ()):
+                        edges.add((m, x)); st.append((x, u))
+            for t in self.wiring["remote_call"].get(m, set()) | self.wiring["message_delivery"].get(m, set()):
+                remote.add((m, t)); st.append((t, self.unit_of(t)))
+            for t in self.wiring["data_access"].get(m, set()):
+                data.add((m, t))
+        return {m for m, _ in seen}, edges, remote, data
+
+
+
+class BM25:
+    def __init__(self, docs, k1=1.2, b=0.75):
+        self.ids = list(docs); D = [docs[i] for i in self.ids]
+        self.tf = [collections.Counter(d) for d in D]; self.len = [len(d) for d in D]
+        self.avg = sum(self.len) / max(1, len(D)); self.k1, self.b = k1, b
+        df = collections.Counter(t for c in self.tf for t in c)
+        self.idf = {t: math.log(1 + (len(D) - n + 0.5) / (n + 0.5)) for t, n in df.items()}
+
+    def rank(self, q):
+        """-> [(балл, id)] по убыванию, только ненулевые."""
+        q = collections.Counter(q); sc = []
+        for i, tf in enumerate(self.tf):
+            s = 0.0
+            for t, qn in q.items():
+                if t in tf:
+                    s += self.idf[t] * tf[t] * (self.k1 + 1) / (tf[t] + self.k1 * (1 - self.b + self.b * self.len[i] / self.avg)) * min(qn, 3)
+            if s > 0:
+                sc.append((s, self.ids[i]))
+        return sorted(sc, reverse=True)

+"""Source-file discovery, token normalization and route-prefix matching."""
+import os
+import re
+from baseline_closure import toks
+
+FRONT_EXT = ('.js', '.html', '.htm', '.vue', '.ts', '.jsx', '.tsx')
+SKIP_DIR = {'node_modules', 'target', 'build', 'dist', '.git', 'bower_components'}
+VENDOR = re.compile(r'(\.min\.|^(vue|angular|jquery|bootstrap|echarts|amazeui|iscroll|cropper|aliyun|react|lodash|moment|d3|three)\b)', re.I)
+VOWELS = set('aeiouy')
+
+def stem(w):
+    """Консервативная нормализация английских суффиксов без предметного словаря."""
+    if len(w) >= 5 and w.endswith("ies"):
+        return w[:-3] + "y"
+    if len(w) >= 5 and w.endswith("es") and w[-3] in "sxz" or w.endswith(("ches", "shes")):
+        w = w[:-2]
+    elif len(w) >= 4 and w.endswith("s") and not w.endswith(("ss", "us", "is")):
+        w = w[:-1]
+    for suf in ("ing", "ed"):
+        if w.endswith(suf) and len(w) - len(suf) >= 4 and any(c in VOWELS for c in w[:-len(suf)]):
+            w = w[:-len(suf)]
+            if len(w) > 4 and w[-1] == w[-2] and w[-1] not in VOWELS:
+                w = w[:-1]
+            break
+    return w
+
+
+def ntoks(t):
+    return [stem(w) for w in toks(t)]
+
+
+def prefix_match(segs, tpl):
+    """Литерал пути из фронтенда против шаблона обработчика: литерал может обрываться перед хвостом из переменных
+    (`"/items/" + itemKey`)."""
+    i = 0
+    for i, s in enumerate(segs):
+        if i >= len(tpl):
+            return False
+        t = tpl[i]
+        if t == "**":
+            return True
+        if not (t.startswith("{") or t == "*" or t == s):
+            return False
+    return all(t.startswith("{") or t in ("*", "**") for t in tpl[len(segs):])
+
+
+def front_files(root):
+    for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(root):
+        dns[:] = [d for d in dns if d not in SKIP_DIR and not d.startswith(".")]
+        for f in fns:
+            if f.endswith(FRONT_EXT) and not VENDOR.search(f):
+                p = os.path.join(dp, f)
+                if os.path.getsize(p) < 400_000:
+                    yield p
+

+"""Reproducible microprojects: changed domains, stateful requests and REST/data wiring."""
+import argparse
+from copy import deepcopy
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'tests'))
+from builders import build, INVENTORY, LIBRARY
+from analyzer.__main__ import analyze, serial
+from analyzer.contracts import ContractGrounder, ContractIndex
+from analyzer.frontend import Frontend
+from analyzer.project import Project
+from analyzer.state import Database
+
+
+def run(project, database, scenario):
+    frontend = Frontend(project)
+    block, report = analyze(project, frontend, ContractIndex(project, frontend), None, database,
+                            {'facts': {}, 'unresolved': []}, scenario, grounder_type=ContractGrounder)
+    return block, report
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--directory', type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    results = []
+    for name, sources, actions, rows in [
+        ('inventory', INVENTORY, ['Reserve key "r4" with enabled true', 'Reserve key "r5" with enabled false'], {'reservations': []}),
+        ('library', LIBRARY, ['Add book key "b2" title "Second"', 'Lookup book key "b2"', 'Lookup book key "absent"'], {'books': []}),
+    ]:
+        project, database, ids = build(args.directory / 'fixtures' / name, sources, module=name, rows=rows)
+        scenario = {'id': 'independent-' + name, 'steps': [{'n': i + 1, 'action': action} for i, action in enumerate(actions)]}
+        before = deepcopy(database.tables)
+        block, report = run(project, database, scenario)
+        alternatives = [s['alternatives'][0] for s in report['steps']]
+        assert database.tables == before
+        if name == 'inventory':
+            assert alternatives[0]['entry'] == ids['StockController.reserve']
+            assert alternatives[0]['parameters'] == {'key': 'r4', 'enabled': True}
+            assert alternatives[1]['parameters'] == {'key': 'r5', 'enabled': False}
+            assert alternatives[0]['result']['key'] == 'r4'
+            assert alternatives[1]['result'] is None
+            assert alternatives[1]['state_after']['database_rows']['inventory.reservations'] == 1
+        else:
+            assert [a['entry'] for a in alternatives] == [ids['BookController.add'], ids['BookController.lookup'], ids['BookController.lookup']]
+            assert alternatives[1]['result'] == 'Second'
+            assert alternatives[2]['result'] == 'absent'
+        renamed = deepcopy(scenario)
+        renamed['id'] = 'another-arbitrary-name'
+        other, _ = run(project, database, renamed)
+        def normalize(answer):
+            return {('scenario' if e['relation'] == 'executes' else e['source'], e['relation'], e['target']) for e in answer['edges']}
+        assert normalize(block) == normalize(other)
+        results.append({'project': name, 'passed': True, 'scenario': scenario, 'answer': block, 'report': report})
+
+    # Two independently indexed services, merged into the supplied skeleton schema.
+    sources = {
+        'shop': {'Shop.java': '''@RestController class Shop {
+          RestTemplate http;
+          @PostMapping("/orders") Receipt place(@RequestBody Request input) {
+            return http.postForObject("http://ledger/charges", new HttpEntity(new Charge(input.sku)), Receipt.class);
+          }
+        }
+        class Request { String sku; }
+        class Receipt { String key; }
+        class Charge { String key; Charge(String key) { this.key = key; } }'''},
+        'ledger': {'Ledger.java': '''@RestController class Ledger {
+          Store repository;
+          @PostMapping("/charges") Charge charge(@RequestBody Charge input) { repository.save(input); return input; }
+          @GetMapping("/charges/{key}") Charge lookup(@PathVariable String key) { return repository.findByKey(key); }
+        }
+        @Entity @Table(name="charges") class Charge { @Id String key; }
+        interface Store extends JpaRepository<Charge,String> { Charge save(Charge item); Charge findByKey(String key); }'''}
+    }
+    root = args.directory / 'fixtures' / 'remote'
+    merged = {'project': 'fixture', 'nodes': {}, 'edges': [], 'context': {}}
+    dump = []
+    for module, files in sources.items():
+        _, _, _ids = build(root / module, files, module=module, rows={'charges': []} if module == 'ledger' else {})
+        skeleton = json.loads((root / module / 'skeleton.json').read_text())
+        for node in skeleton['nodes'].values():
+            if node.get('file'):
+                node['file'] = module + '/' + node['file']
+            for origin in node.get('origin', []):
+                if origin.get('file'):
+                    origin['file'] = module + '/' + origin['file']
+        merged['nodes'].update(skeleton['nodes'])
+        merged['edges'].extend(skeleton['edges'])
+        dump.append((root / module / 'initial.sql').read_text())
+    (root / 'skeleton.json').write_text(json.dumps(merged))
+    (root / 'initial.sql').write_text('\n'.join(dump))
+    project, database = Project(root / 'skeleton.json', root), Database(root / 'initial.sql')
+    scenario = {'id': 'independent-remote', 'steps': [
+        {'n': 1, 'action': 'Place order sku "item-7"'}, {'n': 2, 'action': 'Lookup charge key "item-7"'}]}
+    block, report = run(project, database, scenario)
+    assert any(e['relation'] == 'remote' and e['source'].startswith('method:shop:')
+               and e['target'].startswith('method:ledger:') for e in block['edges'])
+    assert any(e['relation'] == 'data' and e['target'] == 'res:table:ledger.charges' for e in block['edges'])
+    assert report['steps'][1]['alternatives'][0]['result']['key'] == 'item-7'
+    results.append({'project': 'remote', 'passed': True, 'scenario': scenario, 'answer': block, 'report': report})
+    path = args.directory / 'generalization.json'
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'independent microprojects, not evidence of general repository support',
+                                'results': results}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=serial) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'projects': [r['project'] for r in results]}))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Run inference with Python audit hooks blocking network and reference inputs."""
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+written_outputs = set()
+audit_stats = {'blocked_network': 0, 'blocked_processes': 0, 'blocked_reference_reads': 0, 'python_file_reads': 0}
+
+
+def audit(event, args):
+    if event in ('socket.connect', 'socket.getaddrinfo', 'subprocess.Popen', 'os.system'):
+        audit_stats['blocked_network' if event.startswith('socket.') else 'blocked_processes'] += 1
+        raise PermissionError('Offline inference blocked: ' + event)
+    if event == 'open' and isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes)):
+        path, mode, _ = args
+        reading = not isinstance(mode, str) or not any(c in mode for c in 'wax')
+        if not reading:
+            written_outputs.add(str(Path(path).resolve()))
+        else:
+            audit_stats['python_file_reads'] += 1
+        parts = Path(path).parts
+        if reading and (any(p in ('gold', 'runs', 'sample', 'benchmark') for p in parts)
+                        or Path(path).name in ('submission.json', 'solution.zip')) and str(Path(path).resolve()) not in written_outputs:
+            audit_stats['blocked_reference_reads'] += 1
+            raise PermissionError('Reference/previous-answer input blocked: ' + str(path))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    from analyzer.portable import main
+    sys.addaudithook(audit)
+    try:
+        main()
+    finally:
+        import json
+        if '--report' in sys.argv:
+            report_path = Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--report') + 1])
+            report_path.with_name(report_path.stem + '-offline-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit_stats, indent=2) + '\n')

+"""Package a checked variant without virtual environments, caches or model weights."""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import zipfile
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open('rb') as stream:
+        for data in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+            h.update(data)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def main():
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    answer = json.loads((root / 'submission.json').read_text())
+    report = json.loads((root / 'benchmark/analysis-report.json').read_text())
+    evaluation = json.loads((root / 'benchmark/evaluation.json').read_text())
+    format_check = json.loads((root / 'benchmark/format_check.json').read_text())
+    if (not answer['scenarios'] or format_check['status'] != 'format_only'
+            or not report.get('run_complete') or set(answer['scenarios']) != set(report['requested_scenarios'])):
+        raise ValueError('Answer or saved format verification is missing')
+    manifest = {'solution': int(re.search(r'Решение № (\d+)', (root / 'README.md').read_text())[1]),
+                'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                'site_score': None, 'local_score': evaluation['score'],
+                'submission_sha256': digest(root / 'submission.json'),
+                'seconds': report['elapsed_seconds'], 'peak_rss_bytes': report['peak_rss_bytes'],
+                'analysis_status': {sid: r['analysis_status'] for sid, r in report['scenarios'].items()},
+                'code_sha256': {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): digest(p)
+                                for p in sorted((root / 'code').rglob('*')) if p.is_file()
+                                and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}}
+    (root / 'benchmark/run.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
+    paths = [p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()
+             and not any(part in ('.venv', '__pycache__', '.pytest_cache', 'cache') for part in p.relative_to(root).parts)
+             and p.name not in ('.DS_Store', 'solution.zip', 'archive-check.json')
+             and not p.name.startswith('reproduction-')]
+    archive = root / 'solution.zip'
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipped:
+        for path in sorted(paths):
+            zipped.write(path, path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zipped:
+        if zipped.testzip() is not None or zipped.read('submission.json') != (root / 'submission.json').read_bytes():
+            raise ValueError('Archive integrity check failed')
+        check = {'sha256': digest(archive), 'bytes': archive.stat().st_size,
+                 'files': len(zipped.namelist()), 'root_submission_matches': True, 'testzip': 'passed'}
+    (root / 'benchmark/archive-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(check, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps(check, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Construct skeleton fixtures by parsing Java; never compile or execute them."""
+import json
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from tree_sitter import Language, Parser
+import tree_sitter_java
+from analyzer.project import Project, text, walk
+from analyzer.state import Database
+
+
+def annotations(node):
+    mods = next((c for c in node.named_children if c.type == 'modifiers'), None)
+    return [{'name': text(a.child_by_field_name('name')), 'args': text(a.child_by_field_name('arguments'))}
+            for a in mods.named_children if a.type in ('annotation', 'marker_annotation')] if mods else []
+
+
+def build(root, sources, module='service', rows=None, context=None):
+    root = Path(root)
+    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    parser = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_java.language()))
+    nodes = {'module:' + module: {'kind': 'module', 'name': module, 'deployment_units': [module]}}
+    declarations, type_ids, trees = {}, {}, {}
+    for file, source in sources.items():
+        path = root / file
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source)
+        tree = parser.parse(source.encode())
+        assert not tree.root_node.has_error
+        trees[file] = tree
+        for decl in walk(tree.root_node):
+            if decl.type not in ('class_declaration', 'interface_declaration', 'enum_declaration'):
+                continue
+            name = text(decl.child_by_field_name('name'))
+            tid = 'type:' + module + ':' + name
+            type_ids[name] = tid
+            nodes[tid] = dict(kind='type', fqn=name, module=module, file=file, annotations=annotations(decl))
+            declarations[name] = decl
+    ids, methods = {}, []
+    for name, decl in declarations.items():
+        body = decl.child_by_field_name('body')
+        for node in body.named_children:
+            if node.type not in ('method_declaration', 'constructor_declaration'):
+                continue
+            method_name = '<init>' if node.type == 'constructor_declaration' else text(node.child_by_field_name('name'))
+            parameters = node.child_by_field_name('parameters')
+            pars = [text(p.child_by_field_name('type')) for p in parameters.named_children if p.type == 'formal_parameter']
+            mid = f'method:{module}:{name}#{method_name}({",".join(pars)})'
+            ids[name + '.' + method_name] = mid
+            file = nodes[type_ids[name]]['file']
+            nodes[mid] = dict(kind='method', name=method_name, owner=type_ids[name], module=module,
+                              file=file, line=node.start_point.row + 1, end=node.end_point.row + 1,
+                              params_as_written=pars, abstract=node.child_by_field_name('body') is None,
+                              annotations=annotations(node), return_raw=text(node.child_by_field_name('type')))
+            methods.append((mid, name, node))
+    resources = {}
+    for name, decl in declarations.items():
+        table = re.search(r'@Table\(name\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', text(decl))
+        if table:
+            rid = 'res:table:' + module + '.' + table[1]
+            resources[name] = rid
+            nodes[rid] = dict(kind='data_resource', resource_kind='table', schema=module,
+                              name=table[1], origin=[{'file': nodes[type_ids[name]]['file']}])
+    edges = []
+    for name, declaration in declarations.items():
+        parent = re.search(r'implements\s+(\w+)', text(declaration).split('{', 1)[0])
+        if parent and parent[1] in type_ids:
+            edges.append({'source': type_ids[name], 'type': 'implements', 'target': type_ids[parent[1]]})
+            for key, interface_mid in ids.items():
+                if key.startswith(parent[1] + '.'):
+                    implementation = ids.get(name + '.' + key.split('.', 1)[1])
+                    if implementation:
+                        edges.append({'source': implementation, 'type': 'overrides', 'target': interface_mid})
+    for mid, owner, method in methods:
+        variable_types = {}
+        for node in walk(declarations[owner]):
+            if node.type in ('field_declaration', 'local_variable_declaration'):
+                typ = text(node.child_by_field_name('type'))
+                for var in node.named_children:
+                    if var.type == 'variable_declarator':
+                        variable_types[text(var.child_by_field_name('name'))] = typ
+        parameters = method.child_by_field_name('parameters')
+        for par in parameters.named_children:
+            if par.type == 'formal_parameter':
+                variable_types[text(par.child_by_field_name('name'))] = text(par.child_by_field_name('type'))
+        for call in walk(method):
+            if call.type not in ('method_invocation', 'object_creation_expression'):
+                continue
+            is_new = call.type == 'object_creation_expression'
+            name_node = call.child_by_field_name('name')
+            name = '<init>' if is_new else text(name_node)
+            receiver = text(call.child_by_field_name('object'))
+            typ = text(call.child_by_field_name('type')) if is_new else variable_types.get(receiver, receiver or owner)
+            row, col = (name_node or call).start_point.row + 1, (name_node or call).start_point.column + 1
+            cid = f'call:{mid}@{row}:{col}'
+            arguments = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+            count = len(arguments.named_children) if arguments else 0
+            nodes[cid] = dict(kind='call_site', method=mid, callee=name, receiver=receiver,
+                              receiver_type=typ, line=row, col=col, arg_count=count,
+                              file=nodes[mid]['file'])
+            target = ids.get(typ + '.' + name)
+            if target:
+                edges.append({'source': cid, 'type': 'calls', 'target': target})
+            declaration = declarations.get(typ)
+            repository = re.search(r'extends\s+JpaRepository<\s*(\w+)', text(declaration)) if declaration else None
+            if repository and repository[1] in resources:
+                edges.append({'source': cid, 'type': 'data_access', 'target': resources[repository[1]]})
+    skeleton = root / 'skeleton.json'
+    skeleton.write_text(json.dumps({'project': 'fixture', 'nodes': nodes, 'edges': edges, 'context': context or {}}))
+    dump = root / 'initial.sql'
+    statements = ['USE `' + module + '`;']
+    for table, records in (rows or {}).items():
+        columns = list(records[0]) if records else ['key']
+        statements.append('CREATE TABLE `' + table + '` (\n' + ',\n'.join(' `' + k + '` varchar(80)' for k in columns) + '\n) ENGINE=InnoDB;')
+        if records:
+            vals = [','.join('NULL' if r[k] is None else str(r[k]) if isinstance(r[k], (int, float)) else "'" + str(r[k]) + "'" for k in columns) for r in records]
+            statements.append('INSERT INTO `' + table + '` VALUES ' + ','.join('(' + v + ')' for v in vals) + ';')
+    dump.write_text('\n'.join(statements) + '\n')
+    return Project(skeleton, root), Database(dump), ids
+
+
+INVENTORY = {
+    'StockController.java': '''import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
+    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
+    @RestController class StockController {
+      @Autowired StockWorker worker;
+      @PostMapping("/reserve") Reservation reserve(@RequestBody StockRequest input) {
+        if (input.enabled) { return worker.accept(input.key); }
+        return worker.reject(input.key);
+      }
+      @GetMapping("/inventory") String inspect(String key) { return worker.status(key); }
+      @PostMapping("/release") Reservation release(@RequestBody StockRequest input) { return worker.reject(input.key); }
+    }''',
+    'StockWorker.java': '''import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
+    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
+    @Service class StockWorker {
+      @Autowired ReservationStore repository;
+      Reservation accept(String key) { Reservation item = new Reservation(key); repository.save(item); return item; }
+      Reservation reject(String key) { return null; }
+      String status(String key) { return "ready"; }
+    }''',
+    'StockRequest.java': 'class StockRequest { String key; boolean enabled; }',
+    'Reservation.java': 'import jakarta.persistence.*; @Entity @Table(name="reservations") class Reservation { @Id String key; protected Reservation() {} Reservation(String key) { this.key = key; } }',
+    'ReservationStore.java': 'import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository; interface ReservationStore extends JpaRepository<Reservation, String> { Reservation save(Reservation item); }',
+}
+
+LIBRARY = {
+    'BookController.java': '''import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
+    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
+    @RestController class BookController {
+      @Autowired BookStore repository;
+      @GetMapping("/books/{key}") String lookup(@PathVariable String key) {
+        Book found = repository.findByKey(key);
+        if (found == null) { return missing(); }
+        return available(found);
+      }
+      String missing() { return "absent"; }
+      String available(Book found) { return found.title; }
+      @GetMapping("/catalog") String search(String query) { return "matches"; }
+      @PostMapping("/books") Book add(@RequestBody Book input) { repository.save(input); return input; }
+    }''',
+    'Book.java': 'import jakarta.persistence.*; @Entity @Table(name="books") class Book { @Id String key; String title; }',
+    'BookStore.java': 'import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository; interface BookStore extends JpaRepository<Book, String> { Book findByKey(String key); Book save(Book input); }',
+}

+from analyzer.paths import run_paths
+from analyzer.state import ScenarioState, U
+from builders import build
+
+
+def execute(tmp_path, body, typ='int', params=None, constraints=True):
+    sources = {'Rules.java': 'class Rules { int apply(' + typ + ' x) {' + body + '} }'}
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, sources)
+    paths = run_paths(project, ScenarioState(db), ids['Rules.apply'], params or {}, 16, constraints=constraints)
+    return paths
+
+
+def test_nested_opposite_numeric_guard_is_infeasible(tmp_path):
+    code = 'if (x > 5) { if (x <= 5) { return 99; } return 1; } return 2;'
+    before = execute(tmp_path / 'before', code, constraints=False)
+    after = execute(tmp_path / 'after', code)
+    assert {p['result'] for p in before} == {1, 2, 99}
+    assert {p['result'] for p in after} == {1, 2}
+    assert len(after) == 2
+    assert any(c.get('refined') for p in after for c in p['engine'].conditions)
+
+
+def test_integer_boundary_and_reversed_comparison(tmp_path):
+    paths = execute(tmp_path, 'if (5 < x) { if (x >= 6) { return 1; } return 99; } return 2;')
+    assert {p['result'] for p in paths} == {1, 2}
+
+
+def test_floating_point_guard_keeps_noninteger_interval(tmp_path):
+    paths = execute(tmp_path, 'if (x > 5) { if (x >= 5.5) { return 1; } return 3; } return 2;', 'double')
+    assert {p['result'] for p in paths} == {1, 2, 3}
+    assert len(paths) == 3
+

+"""Тесты разбора Spring-маршрутов в baseline_closure."""
+import os
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+import pytest
+
+from baseline_closure import Index, RouteWarning, ann_paths
+
+
+def _ann(name, args):
+    return {"name": name, "args": args}
+
+
+def test_value_and_path_attrs_only():
+    assert ann_paths([_ann("PostMapping", 'value = "/tickets", produces = "application/json"')]) == [("POST", ["/tickets"])]
+    assert ann_paths([_ann("PutMapping", 'path = "/p", consumes = "text/plain"')]) == [("PUT", ["/p"])]
+    assert ann_paths([_ann("org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping", '"/tickets"')]) == [("GET", ["/tickets"])]
+    assert ann_paths([_ann("CustomMapping", '"/skip"'), _ann("Service", "")]) == []
+
+
+def test_method_array_expands_to_separate_tuples():
+    anns = [_ann("RequestMapping", 'value = {"/a", "/b"}, method = {RequestMethod.GET, RequestMethod.POST}')]
+    assert ann_paths(anns) == [("GET", ["/a", "/b"]), ("POST", ["/a", "/b"])]
+    assert ann_paths([_ann("RequestMapping", '"/x"')]) == [("REQUEST", ["/x"])]
+    assert ann_paths([_ann("DeleteMapping", "")]) == [("DELETE", [""])]
+
+
+def test_symbolic_path_warns_without_route():
+    with pytest.warns(RouteWarning):
+        assert ann_paths([_ann("GetMapping", "ApiPaths.TICKETS")]) == []
+
+
+def test_index_unions_class_and_method_verbs_with_class_prefix():
+    cls_post = [_ann("RequestMapping", 'value = "/api", method = RequestMethod.POST')]
+    cls_plain = [_ann("RequestMapping", '"/api"')]
+    m_get = [_ann("GetMapping", '"/list"')]
+    m_plain = [_ann("RequestMapping", '"/list"')]
+
+    def build(class_anns, method_anns):
+        return Index({"nodes": {
+            "ctrl": {"id": "ctrl", "kind": "type", "name": "Ctrl", "annotations": class_anns},
+            "list": {"id": "list", "kind": "method", "owner": "ctrl", "name": "list",
+                     "module": "ctrl", "annotations": method_anns},
+        }, "edges": []})
+
+    both = build(cls_post, m_get)
+    assert sorted(h[1] for h in both.handlers) == ["GET", "POST"]
+    assert both.handlers_for("GET", "/api/list") == {"list"}
+    assert both.handlers_for("POST", "/api/list") == {"list"}
+    assert both.handlers_for("GET", "/list") == set()
+
+    assert [h[1] for h in build(cls_plain, m_get).handlers] == ["GET"]
+    assert [h[1] for h in build(cls_post, m_plain).handlers] == ["POST"]

+"""Explicit labelled numeric extraction: narrow, evidence-only behavior."""
+import os
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+from analyzer.state import U
+from analyzer.structured_literals import literal_value
+
+
+def test_labelled_integer_sequence_preserves_order():
+    value, quote = literal_value('Add experiment with temperatures 0, 100 and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>')
+    assert value == [0, 100, 250]
+    assert quote == 'temperatures 0, 100 and 250'
+
+
+def test_scalar_float_requires_explicit_caller_label():
+    assert literal_value('Add reagent with basic rate 0.5', 'basicPriceRate', 'double') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Add reagent with basic rate 0.5', 'basicPriceRate', 'double', ('basic rate',)) == (0.5, 'basic rate 0.5')
+
+
+def test_conflicting_repeated_labels_are_refused():
+    assert literal_value('Set temperature 10 and temperature 20', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('temperatures 10 and temperatures 20', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
+
+
+def test_malformed_collection_item_rejects_the_whole_list():
+    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, 100.5 and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, hot and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('temperatures 2026-10-17', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, 100 and 250 with a catalyst', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == ([0, 100, 250], 'temperatures 0, 100 and 250')
+
+
+def test_partial_and_unrelated_numbers_are_ignored():
+    assert literal_value('Set temperature 0.5', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Set temperature 09:00', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Set temperature 2026-10-17', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Add 3 experiments in room 5', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Add temperatureSensor value 100', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Add temperature2 value 100', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Add 4 runs', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
+
+
+def test_one_malformed_repeated_occurrence_is_ambiguous():
+    assert literal_value('temperature 10 and temperature unknown', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('temperature unknown and temperature 10', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Set temperature 10', 'temperature', 'int', ('temperature',)) == (10, 'temperature 10')
+    assert literal_value('basic rate 0.5', 'rate', 'double', ('basic rate',)) == (0.5, 'basic rate 0.5')
+
+
+def test_dangling_separator_repeated_labels_and_nonfinite_numbers():
+    assert literal_value('temperatures 1, 2 and', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('temperatures 1 and temperatures 1', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == ([1], 'temperatures 1')
+    assert literal_value('Set ratio ' + '1' * 400, 'ratio', 'double') == (U, '')
+    assert literal_value('Stay time of 5 minutes', 'stayTime', 'int') == (5, 'Stay time of 5')

+from copy import deepcopy

+from analyzer.state import ScenarioState, U
+from builders import build, INVENTORY, LIBRARY
+
+
+class StaticRetrieval:
+    def __init__(self, methods):
+        self.methods = methods
+
+    def candidates(self, action):
+        return self.methods
+
+
+class Proposal:
+    def __init__(self, handler, bindings):
+        self.handler, self.bindings = handler, bindings
+
+    def propose(self, task, payload, schema):
+        return {'hypotheses': [{'handler': self.handler, 'ui_site': '', 'reason': 'fixture request',
+                                'bindings': deepcopy(self.bindings)}], 'unresolved': []}
+
+
+def binding(parameter, value, quote, source='literal', reference=''):
+    return {'parameter': parameter, 'value': value, 'quote': quote, 'source': source, 'reference': reference}
+
+
+def test_unsupported_model_literal_is_not_used(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, LIBRARY, rows={'books': []})
+    mid = ids['BookController.lookup']
+    frontend = Frontend(project)
+    parser = Proposal(mid, [binding('key', 'invented', 'Open the first book')])
+    grounder = Grounder(project, frontend, StaticRetrieval([mid]), parser, {'facts': {}})
+    proposals, _ = grounder.step('Open the first book', ScenarioState(db))
+    assert 'key' not in proposals[0]['params']
+    assert any('Unsupported' in warning for warning in proposals[0]['unresolved'])
+
+

+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, LIBRARY, rows={'books': []})

+    grounder = Grounder(project, Frontend(project), StaticRetrieval([mid]), parser, {'facts': {}})
+    proposals, detail = grounder.step('Open book', ScenarioState(db))
+    assert not proposals and detail['unresolved']
+
+
+def test_context_changes_propagate_to_request(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, LIBRARY, rows={'books': []})
+    mid = ids['BookController.lookup']
+    parser = Proposal(mid, [binding('key', None, '', 'context', 'chosen_key')])
+    values = []
+    for value in ('first', 'second'):
+        context = {'facts': {'chosen_key': {'value': value, 'kind': 'default', 'quote': value}}}
+        grounder = Grounder(project, Frontend(project), StaticRetrieval([mid]), parser, context)
+        choices, _ = grounder.step('Open book', ScenarioState(db))

+"""Check the exported graph against its explanations without a reference answer."""
+import argparse
+from collections import Counter
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def edges(items):
+    result = {(e['source'], e['relation'], e['target']) for e in items}
+    assert len(result) == len(items), 'Duplicate exported edges'
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--submission', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--report', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    answer = json.loads(args.submission.read_text())
+    report = json.loads(args.report.read_text())
+    assert set(answer['scenarios']) == set(report['scenarios'])
+    summary = {}
+    for sid, block in answer['scenarios'].items():
+        detail = report['scenarios'][sid]
+        exported = edges(block['edges'])
+        confirmed, possible = edges(detail['confirmed']), edges(detail['possible'])
+        assert not confirmed & possible and exported == confirmed | possible
+        evidence = {tuple(item['edge'][k] for k in ('source', 'relation', 'target')): item['grounds']
+                    for item in detail['evidence']}
+        assert set(evidence) == exported, 'Every edge needs its grounds'
+        steps = {s['n']: s for s in detail['steps']}
+        for edge, grounds in evidence.items():
+            assert grounds
+            for ground in grounds:
+                alternative = steps[ground['step']]['alternatives'][ground['alternative']]
+                assert edge in edges(alternative['edges'])
+                assert ground['source_sites'] and ground['source_locations'] and ground['applied_rules']
+                assert ground['entry'] == alternative['entry']
+        summary[sid] = {
+            'status': detail['analysis_status'], 'confirmed': len(confirmed), 'possible': len(possible),
+            'relations': dict(Counter(e['relation'] for e in block['edges'])),
+            'steps': len(detail['steps']),
+            'steps_without_request': [s['n'] for s in detail['steps'] if not s['alternatives']],
+            'steps_with_limits': [s['n'] for s in detail['steps'] if any(a['unresolved'] for a in s['alternatives'])],
+            'unresolved_count': len(detail['unresolved'])}
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'checks': [
+        'same scenario sets', 'unique edges', 'confirmed/possible partition',
+        'grounds for every edge', 'valid step and alternative references',
+        'source locations and applied rules'], 'scenarios': summary}, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

# Skill: karpathy-guidelines

# Karpathy Guidelines

Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from [Andrej Karpathy's observations](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) on LLM coding pitfalls.

**Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.

## 1. Think Before Coding

**Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**

Before implementing:
- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
- If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.
- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.

## 2. Simplicity First

**Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**

- No features beyond what was asked.
- No abstractions for single-use code.
- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
- No error handling for impossible scenarios.
- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.

Ask yourself: "Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?" If yes, simplify.

## 3. Surgical Changes

**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**

When editing existing code:
- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.

When your changes create orphans:
- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.
- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.

The test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.

## 4. Goal-Driven Execution

**Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**

Transform tasks into verifiable goals:
- "Add validation" → "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass"
- "Fix the bug" → "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass"
- "Refactor X" → "Ensure tests pass before and after"

For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
```
1. [Step] → verify: [check]
2. [Step] → verify: [check]
3. [Step] → verify: [check]
```

Strong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.

    """Spring MVC specificity for the supported segment-pattern subset."""
    variables = sum(part.startswith('{') for part in template)
    wildcards = sum(part == '*' for part in template)
    catchalls = sum(part == '**' or part.startswith('{*') for part in template)
    length = sum(1 if part.startswith('{') else len(part) for part in template) + len(template)
    return (-bool(catchalls), -variables - wildcards - 2 * catchalls, length, variables - wildcards)

def _scope(project, mid):

    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_cache', {})

    return result

from builders import build

BATCH = {'Batch.java': 'class Batch { int premiumSlots; int standardSlots; }'}


def _line(source, needle):
    return next(number for number, line in enumerate(source.splitlines(), 1) if needle in line)


def _manual_project(root, sources, nodes):
    for file, source in sources.items():
        path = root / file
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(source)
    skeleton = root / 'skeleton.json'
    skeleton.write_text(json.dumps({'project': 'fixture', 'nodes': nodes, 'edges': [], 'context': {}}))
    return Project(skeleton, root)


def test_chained_getter_alias_keeps_method_line_evidence(tmp_path):
    reader = '''class Reader {
  int read(Result result) {
    int priorityTotalCount = result.getBatch().getPremiumSlots();
    int plainCount = result.getBatch().getStandardSlots();
    return priorityTotalCount + plainCount;
  }
}'''
    project, _, ids = build(tmp_path, {'Api.java': 'class Api { void submit(@RequestBody Batch body) { } }',
                                       'Result.java': 'class Result { Batch batch; }',
                                       'Reader.java': reader, **BATCH})
    assert field_aliases(project, ids['Api.submit']) == {
        'premiumSlots': [{'label': 'priorityTotalCount',
                          'reference': f'{ids["Reader.read"]}:{_line(reader, "priorityTotalCount")}'}],
        'standardSlots': [{'label': 'plainCount',
                           'reference': f'{ids["Reader.read"]}:{_line(reader, "plainCount")}'}]}


def test_duplicate_simple_names_in_packages_do_not_cross_bind(tmp_path):
    sources = {
        'app/a/Batch.java': 'package app.a;\nclass Batch { int premiumSlots; }\n',
        'app/b/Batch.java': 'package app.b;\nclass Batch { int premiumSlots; }\n',
        'app/Api.java': 'package app;\nimport app.a.Batch;\nclass Api { void submit(@RequestBody Batch body) { } }\n',
        'app/Reader.java': 'package app;\nimport app.a.Batch;\n'
                           'class Reader { int read() { Batch typed = null; int total = typed.getPremiumSlots(); return total; } }\n',
        'app/Decoy.java': 'package app;\nimport app.b.Batch;\n'
                          'class Decoy { int probe() { Batch other = null; int copy = other.getPremiumSlots(); return copy; } }\n',
    }
    nodes = {'module:m': {'kind': 'module', 'name': 'm', 'deployment_units': ['m']}}
    for tid, fqn, file in (('type:app.a.Batch', 'app.a.Batch', 'app/a/Batch.java'),

def test_calculated_or_wrapped_values_are_not_direct_getters(tmp_path):

+def csv_fields(project, mid):

+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]

+    result = {}
+    for method, meta in project.methods.items():
+        if meta['owner'] not in roots or method not in project.ast:
+            continue
+        for call in walk(project.ast[method]):
+            if call.type != 'method_invocation' or text(call.child_by_field_name('name')) != 'split':
+                continue
+            receiver = call.child_by_field_name('object')
+            field = text(receiver).removeprefix('this.')
+            args = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+            if field not in project.type_fields[meta['owner']] or args is None or len(args.named_children) != 1:
+                continue
+            if text(args.named_children[0]) != '\",\"':
+                continue
+            alias = meta['name'][3:] if meta['name'].startswith('get') else ''
+            result[field] = {'delimiter': ',', 'label': alias, 'reference': method + ':' + str(call.start_point.row + 1)}
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result

+def field_labels(fields, field):

+"""Local aliases for request DTO fields, proven by getter chains in source.
+
+For a handler mid, field_aliases() takes the declared @RequestBody types and
+reports which local variable names are directly initialized (or directly
+assigned) from a zero-argument getter whose receiver resolves to exactly one
+of those DTO types. The getter suffix must match a field actually declared by
+that DTO type (getFoo -> foo). Only the full local name and method:line
+evidence are recorded: no input values, synonyms or semantic equivalents are
+invented, and unresolved types or receivers contribute no facts.
+"""
+import re
+
+from .project import text, walk
+
+
+def _getter_field(name):
+    return name[3].lower() + name[4:] if re.fullmatch(r'get[A-Z]\w*', name) else None
+
+
+def _arguments(invocation):
+    arguments = invocation.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+    return [child for child in arguments.named_children
+            if child.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if arguments else []
+
+
+def _declared(project, tid):
+    return project.type_fields.get(tid, {})
+
+
+def _scope(project, mid):
+    """Identifier -> (written type, file); plus names bound as parameters or locals."""
+    node = project.ast.get(mid)
+    if node is None:
+        return {}, set()
+    method = project.methods[mid]
+    scope, bindings = {}, set()
+    for name, field in project.type_fields.get(method['owner'], {}).items():
+        scope[name] = (field['type'], field['file'])
+    parameters = node.child_by_field_name('parameters')
+    for parameter in parameters.named_children if parameters else []:
+        if parameter.type == 'formal_parameter':
+            name = text(parameter.child_by_field_name('name'))
+            scope[name] = (text(parameter.child_by_field_name('type')), method['file'])
+            bindings.add(name)
+    for declaration in walk(node):
+        if declaration.type != 'local_variable_declaration':
+            continue
+        written = text(declaration.child_by_field_name('type'))
+        for variable in declaration.named_children:
+            if variable.type == 'variable_declarator':
+                name = text(variable.child_by_field_name('name'))
+                scope[name] = (written, method['file'])
+                bindings.add(name)
+    return scope, bindings
+
+
+def _expr_type(project, expression, scope, module, file, owner):
+    """Type id for an identifier, this, field access or zero-arg declared getter."""
+    if expression is None:
+        return None
+    if expression.type == 'identifier':
+        entry = scope.get(text(expression))
+        return project.resolve_type(entry[0], module, entry[1]) if entry else None
+    if expression.type == 'this':
+        return owner
+    if expression.type == 'field_access':
+        base = _expr_type(project, expression.child_by_field_name('object'), scope, module, file, owner)
+        field = _declared(project, base).get(text(expression.child_by_field_name('field')))
+        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
+    if expression.type == 'method_invocation':
+        if _arguments(expression):
+            return None
+        name = _getter_field(text(expression.child_by_field_name('name')))
+        receiver = expression.child_by_field_name('object')
+        base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
+        field = _declared(project, base).get(name) if name else None
+        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
+    return None
+
+
+def _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, module, file, owner):
+    """Declared root DTO field read by a direct zero-arg getter value, else None."""
+    if value is None or value.type != 'method_invocation' or _arguments(value):
+        return None
+    field = _getter_field(text(value.child_by_field_name('name')))
+    receiver = value.child_by_field_name('object')
+    base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
+    return field if field and base in roots and field in _declared(project, base) else None
+
+
+def _scan(project, roots):
+    found = []
+    for mid in sorted(project.methods):
+        node = project.ast.get(mid)
+        if node is None:
+            continue
+        method = project.methods[mid]
+        scope, bindings = _scope(project, mid)
+        for statement in walk(node):
+            pairs = []
+            if statement.type == 'local_variable_declaration':
+                pairs = [(text(variable.child_by_field_name('name')), variable.child_by_field_name('value'))
+                         for variable in statement.named_children if variable.type == 'variable_declarator']
+            elif statement.type == 'assignment_expression' and text(statement.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '=':
+                left = statement.child_by_field_name('left')
+                if left.type == 'identifier' and text(left) in bindings:
+                    pairs = [(text(left), statement.child_by_field_name('right'))]
+            for label, value in pairs:
+                field = _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, method['module'], method['file'], method['owner'])
+                if field:
+                    found.append((field, label, mid, statement.start_point.row + 1))
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(found))
+
+
+def field_aliases(project, mid):
+    """Field aliases for the @RequestBody declared types of mid.
+
+    Returns {field: [{'label': local name, 'reference': 'source_mid:line'}]}.
+    Every indexed source method is scanned for direct getter-chain evidence;
+    the scan is shared between calls with the same root type set and results
+    are cached per mid. Fields without proven aliases are omitted.
+    """
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_cache', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    method = project.methods.get(mid)
+    roots = set()
+    if method:
+        for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
+            if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
+                continue
+            tid = project.resolve_type(parameter['type'], method['module'], method['file'])
+            if project.type_fields.get(tid):
+                roots.add(tid)
+    result = {}
+    if roots:
+        scans = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_scan', {})
+        key = tuple(sorted(roots))
+        if key not in scans:
+            scans[key] = _scan(project, roots)
+        for field, label, source, line in scans[key]:
+            result.setdefault(field, []).append({'label': label, 'reference': f'{source}:{line}'})
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result

# Skill: karpathy-guidelines

# Karpathy Guidelines

Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from [Andrej Karpathy's observations](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) on LLM coding pitfalls.

**Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.

## 1. Think Before Coding

**Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**

Before implementing:
- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
- If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.
- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.

## 2. Simplicity First

**Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**

- No features beyond what was asked.
- No abstractions for single-use code.
- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
- No error handling for impossible scenarios.
- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.

Ask yourself: "Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?" If yes, simplify.

## 3. Surgical Changes

**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**

When editing existing code:
- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.

When your changes create orphans:
- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.

"""Explicit labelled numeric extraction: narrow, evidence-only behavior."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from analyzer.state import U
from analyzer.structured_literals import literal_value


def test_labelled_integer_sequence_preserves_order():
    value, quote = literal_value('Add experiment with temperatures 0, 100 and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>')
    assert value == [0, 100, 250]
    assert quote == 'temperatures 0, 100 and 250'


def test_scalar_float_requires_explicit_caller_label():
    assert literal_value('Add reagent with basic rate 0.5', 'basicPriceRate', 'double') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add reagent with basic rate 0.5', 'basicPriceRate', 'double', ('basic rate',)) == (0.5, 'basic rate 0.5')


def test_conflicting_repeated_labels_are_refused():
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 10 and temperature 20', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 10 and temperatures 20', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')


def test_malformed_collection_item_rejects_the_whole_list():
    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, 100.5 and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, hot and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 2026-10-17', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, 100 and 250 with a catalyst', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == ([0, 100, 250], 'temperatures 0, 100 and 250')


def test_partial_and_unrelated_numbers_are_ignored():
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 0.5', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 09:00', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 2026-10-17', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add 3 experiments in room 5', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add temperatureSensor value 100', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add temperature2 value 100', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add 4 runs', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')


def test_one_malformed_repeated_occurrence_is_ambiguous():
    assert literal_value('temperature 10 and temperature unknown', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperature unknown and temperature 10', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 10', 'temperature', 'int', ('temperature',)) == (10, 'temperature 10')
    assert literal_value('basic rate 0.5', 'rate', 'double', ('basic rate',)) == (0.5, 'basic rate 0.5')


def test_dangling_separator_repeated_labels_and_nonfinite_numbers():
    assert literal_value('temperatures 1, 2 and', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 1 and temperatures 1', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == ([1], 'temperatures 1')
    assert literal_value('Set ratio ' + '1' * 400, 'ratio', 'double') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Stay time of 5 minutes', 'stayTime', 'int') == (5, 'Stay time of 5')

```python
"""Source-only aliases between request DTO fields and local variable names.

For a handler mid, field_aliases() proves, from Java source alone, which local
names are directly initialized or assigned from a zero-argument getter chain
rooted in exactly one @RequestBody declared type. The getter suffix must match
a field actually declared by that DTO type (getFoo -> foo). The result records
only the full local name and method:line evidence: no values, synonyms or
semantic equivalents are invented, and unresolved types yield no facts.
"""
import re

from .project import text, walk


def _getter_field(name):
    return name[3].lower() + name[4:] if re.fullmatch(r'get[A-Z]\w*', name) else None


def _arguments(invocation):
    arguments = invocation.child_by_field_name('arguments')
    return [a for a in arguments.named_children if a.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if arguments else []


def _declared(project, tid):
    return project.type_fields.get(tid, {})


def _scope(project, mid):
    """Identifier -> (written type, file) plus names bound as parameters/locals."""
    node = project.ast.get(mid)
    if node is None:
        return {}, set()
    method = project.methods[mid]
    file = method['file']
    scope, local = {}, set()
    for name, field in project.type_fields.get(method['owner'], {}).items():
        scope[name] = (field['type'], field['file'])
    parameters = node.child_by_field_name('parameters')
    for parameter in parameters.named_children if parameters else []:
        if parameter.type == 'formal_parameter':
            name = text(parameter.child_by_field_name('name'))
            scope[name] = (text(parameter.child_by_field_name('type')), file)
            local.add(name)
    for declaration in walk(node):
        if declaration.type != 'local_variable_declaration':
            continue
        written = text(declaration.child_by_field_name('type'))
        for variable in declaration.named_children:
            if variable.type == 'variable_declarator':
                name = text(variable.child_by_field_name('name'))
                scope[name] = (written, file)
                local.add(name)
    return scope, local


def _expr_type(project, expression, scope, module, file, owner):
    """Resolve a receiver expression to a type id, or None when unproven."""
    if expression is None:
        return None
    if expression.type == 'identifier':
        entry = scope.get(text(expression))
        return project.resolve_type(entry[0], module, entry[1]) if entry else None
    if expression.type == 'this':
        return owner
    if expression.type == 'field_access':
        base = _expr_type(project, expression.child_by_field_name('object'), scope, module, file, owner)
        field = _declared(project, base).get(text(expression.child_by_field_name('field')))
        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
    if expression.type == 'method_invocation':
        if _arguments(expression):
            return None
        name = _getter_field(text(expression.child_by_field_name('name')))
        receiver = expression.child_by_field_name('object')
        base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
        field = _declared(project, base).get(name) if name else None
        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
    return None


def _alias_at(project, value, roots, scope, module, file, owner):
    """Declared root DTO field for a direct zero-arg getter value, else None."""
    if value is None or value.type != 'method_invocation' or _arguments(value):
        return None
    field = _getter_field(text(value.child_by_field_name('name')))
    receiver = value.child_by_field_name('object')
    base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
    return field if field and base in roots and field in _declared(project, base) else None


def _scan(project, roots):
    found = []
    for mid in sorted(project.methods):
        node = project.ast.get(mid)
        if node is None:
            continue
        method = project.methods[mid]
        scope, local = _scope(project, mid)
        for statement in walk(node):
            candidates = []
            if statement.type == 'local_variable_declaration':
                candidates = [(text(v.child_by_field_name('name')), v.child_by_field_name('value'))
                              for v in statement.named_children if v.type == 'variable_declarator']
            elif statement.type == 'assignment_expression' and text(statement.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '=':
                left = statement.child_by_field_name('left')
                if left.type == 'identifier' and text(left) in local:
                    candidates = [(text(left), statement.child_by_field_name('right'))]
            for label, value in candidates:
                field = _alias_at(project, value, roots, scope, method['module'], method['file'], method['owner'])
                if field:
                    found.append((field, label, mid, statement.start_point.row + 1))
    return list(dict.fromkeys(found))


def field_aliases(project, mid):
    """Aliases for fields of mid's @RequestBody DTO declared types.

    Returns {field: [{'label': local name, 'reference': 'method:line'}]},
    scanning every indexed source method for direct getter-chain evidence.
    Cached per mid; the getter scan is shared by equal root type sets.
    """
    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_cache', {})
    if mid in cache:
        return cache[mid]
    method = project.methods.get(mid)
    roots = set()
    if method:
        for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
            if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
                continue
            tid = project.resolve_type(parameter['type'], method['module'], method['file'])
            if project.type_fields.get(tid):
                roots.add(tid)
    result = {}
    if roots:
        scans = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_scan', {})
        key = tuple(sorted(roots))
        if key not in scans:
            scans[key] = _scan(project, roots)
        for field, label, source, line in scans[key]:
            result.setdefault(field, []).append({'label': label, 'reference': f'{source}:{line}'})
    cache[mid] = result
    return result
```

```python
"""Local aliases for request DTO fields, proven by getter chains in source.

For a handler mid, field_aliases() takes the declared @RequestBody types and
reports which local variable names are directly initialized (or directly
assigned) from a zero-argument getter whose receiver resolves to exactly one
of those DTO types. The getter suffix must match a field actually declared by
that DTO type (getFoo -> foo). Only the full local name and method:line
evidence are recorded: no input values, synonyms or semantic equivalents are
invented, and unresolved types or receivers contribute no facts.
"""
import re

from .project import text, walk


def _getter_field(name):
    return name[3].lower() + name[4:] if re.fullmatch(r'get[A-Z]\w*', name) else None


def _arguments(invocation):
    arguments = invocation.child_by_field_name('arguments')
    return [child for child in arguments.named_children if child.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if arguments else []


def _declared(project, tid):
    return project.type_fields.get(tid, {})


def _scope(project, mid):
    """Identifier -> (written type, file); plus names bound as parameters or locals."""
    node = project.ast.get(mid)
    if node is None:
        return {}, set()
    method = project.methods[mid]
    scope, locals_ = {}, set()
    for name, field in project.type_fields.get(method['owner'], {}).items():
        scope[name] = (field['type'], field['file'])
    parameters = node.child_by_field_name('parameters')
    for parameter in parameters.named_children if parameters else []:
        if parameter.type == 'formal_parameter':
            name = text(parameter.child_by_field_name('name'))
            scope[name] = (text(parameter.child_by_field_name('type')), method['file'])
            locals_.add(name)
    for declaration in walk(node):
        if declaration.type != 'local_variable_declaration':
            continue
        written = text(declaration.child_by_field_name('type'))
        for variable in declaration.named_children:
            if variable.type == 'variable_declarator':
                name = text(variable.child_by_field_name('name'))
                scope[name] = (written, method['file'])
                locals_.add(name)
    return scope, locals_


def _expr_type(project, expression, scope, module, file, owner):
    """Type id for an identifier, this, field access or zero-arg declared getter."""
    if expression is None:
        return None
    if expression.type == 'identifier':
        entry = scope.get(text(expression))
        return project.resolve_type(entry[0], module, entry[1]) if entry else None
    if expression.type == 'this':
        return owner
    if expression.type == 'field_access':
        base = _expr_type(project, expression.child_by_field_name('object'), scope, module, file, owner)
        field = _declared(project, base).get(text(expression.child_by_field_name('field')))
        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
    if expression.type == 'method_invocation':
        if _arguments(expression):
            return None
        name = _getter_field(text(expression.child_by_field_name('name')))
        receiver = expression.child_by_field_name('object')
        base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
        field = _declared(project, base).get(name) if name else None
        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
    return None


def _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, module, file, owner):
    """Declared root DTO field read by a direct zero-arg getter value, else None."""
    if value is None or value.type != 'method_invocation' or _arguments(value):
        return None
    field = _getter_field(text(value.child_by_field_name('name')))
    receiver = value.child_by_field_name('object')
    base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
    return field if field and base in roots and field in _declared(project, base) else None


def _scan(project, roots):
    found = []
    for mid in sorted(project.methods):
        node = project.ast.get(mid)
        if node is None:
            continue
        method = project.methods[mid]
        scope, local = _scope(project, mid)
        for statement in walk(node):
            declared = []
            if statement.type == 'local_variable_declaration':
                declared = [(text(var.child_by_field_name('name')), var.child_by_field_name('value'))
                            for var in statement.named_children if var.type == 'variable_declarator']
            elif statement.type == 'assignment_expression' and text(statement.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '=':
                left = statement.child_by_field_name('left')
                if left.type == 'identifier' and text(left) in local:
                    declared = [(text(left), statement.child_by_field_name('right'))]
            for label, value in declared:
                field = _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, method['module'], method['file'], method['owner'])
                if field:
                    found.append((field, label, mid, statement.start_point.row + 1))
    return list(dict.fromkeys(found))


def field_aliases(project, mid):
    """Field aliases for the @RequestBody declared types of mid.

    Returns {field: [{'label': local name, 'reference': 'source_mid:line'}]}.
    Every indexed source method is scanned for direct getter-chain evidence;
    the scan is shared between calls with the same root type set and results
    are cached per mid. Fields without proven aliases are omitted.
    """
    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_cache', {})
    if mid in cache:
        return cache[mid]
    method = project.methods.get(mid)
    roots = set()
    if method:
        for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
            if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
                continue
            tid = project.resolve_type(parameter['type'], method['module'], method['file'])
            if project.type_fields.get(tid):
                roots.add(tid)
    result = {}
    if roots:
        scans = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_scan', {})
        key = tuple(sorted(roots))
        if key not in scans:
            scans[key] = _scan(project, roots)
        for field, label, source, line in scans[key]:
            result.setdefault(field, []).append({'label': label, 'reference': f'{source}:{line}'})
    cache[mid] = result
    return result
```
