+"""Resolve response references by declared entity and explicit selection language."""
+import re
+from baseline_nlp import ntoks
+from .state import U
+from .project import text
+
+
+def source_string(project, value):
+    """Evaluate only source-proven pure toString/getter expressions for composite IDs."""
+    active = set()
+
+    def invoke(obj, tid, name):
+        signature = (tid, name)
+        if tid is None or signature in active:
+            return U
+        methods = [m for m in project.methods_of(tid, name) if not project.parameters(m)]
+        if not methods:
+            if name == 'name' and tid in project.enum_members and isinstance(obj, dict):
+                return obj.get('__enum__', '').rsplit('.', 1)[-1] or U
+            return U
+        if len(methods) != 1:
+            return U
+        node = project.ast.get(methods[0])
+        body = node.child_by_field_name('body') if node else None
+        statements = [s for s in body.named_children if s.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if body else []
+        if len(statements) != 1 or statements[0].type != 'return_statement':
+            return U
+        active.add(signature)
+        result = expression(statements[0].named_children[0], obj, tid)
+        active.remove(signature)
+        return result
+
+    def expression(node, obj, tid):
+        kind = node.type
+        if kind == 'this':
+            return obj
+        if kind == 'identifier':
+            return obj.get(text(node), U)
+        if kind == 'field_access' and text(node.child_by_field_name('object')) == 'this':
+            return obj.get(text(node.child_by_field_name('field')), U)
+        if kind == 'string_literal':
+            import json
+            try:
+                return json.loads(text(node))
+            except ValueError:
+                return U
+        if kind == 'binary_expression' and text(node.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '+':
+            left, right = expression(node.child_by_field_name('left'), obj, tid), expression(node.child_by_field_name('right'), obj, tid)
+            if left is U or right is U or not isinstance(left, (str, int)) or not isinstance(right, (str, int)):
+                return U
+            return str(left) + str(right) if isinstance(left, str) or isinstance(right, str) else left + right
+        if kind == 'method_invocation':
+            args = node.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+            if args and args.named_children:
+                return U
+            receiver = node.child_by_field_name('object')
+            receiver_value = obj if receiver is None else expression(receiver, obj, tid)
+            target = tid
+            if receiver is not None and receiver.type == 'identifier':
+                field = project.type_fields.get(tid, {}).get(text(receiver), {})
+                target = project.resolve_type(field.get('type', ''), project.nodes[tid].get('module'), project.nodes[tid].get('file'))
+            if not isinstance(receiver_value, dict):
+                return U
+            return invoke(receiver_value, target, text(node.child_by_field_name('name')))
+        return U
+
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        return U
+    tid = project.resolve_type(value.get('__type__', ''), '')
+    result = invoke(value, tid, 'toString')
+    return result if isinstance(result, str) else U
+
+
+def contains_unknown(value):
+    if value is U:
+        return True
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return any(contains_unknown(v) for k, v in value.items() if not str(k).startswith('__') or k == '__json__')
+    return isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) and any(contains_unknown(v) for v in value)
+
+
+def entity_words(value):
+    value = re.sub(r'(Controller|Service|Impl|Request|Response|Dto|Info|Entity)$', '', value.split('.')[-1], flags=re.I)
+    return set(ntoks(value)) - {'get', 'find', 'query', 'lookup', 'read', 'create', 'new', 'id', 'key'}
+
+
+def objects(value, path):
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        if value.get('__type__') and '__symbol__' not in value:
+            yield path, value
+        for key, child in value.items():
+            if not str(key).startswith('__'):
+                yield from objects(child, path + '.' + str(key))
+    elif isinstance(value, list):
+        for index, child in enumerate(value):
+            yield from objects(child, path + '[' + str(index) + ']')
+
+
+def ordinal_for(action, requested):
+    for candidate in re.finditer(r'\b(first|second|third|fourth)\b(?!-)', action, re.I):
+        following = re.split(r'[,;()]|\b(?:for|with|without|on|of)\b', action[candidate.end():], 1, flags=re.I)[0]
+        if requested & set(ntoks(following)[:4]):
+            return candidate
+    return None
+
+
+def new_for(action, requested):
+    for candidate in re.finditer(r'\b(?:(?:newly|just|recently)\s+(?:created|added|registered|booked)|new|latest)\b', action, re.I):
+        following = re.split(r'[,;()]|\b(?:for|with|without|on|of)\b', action[candidate.end():], 1, flags=re.I)[0]
+        if requested & set(ntoks(following)[:4]):
+            return candidate
+    return None
+
+
+def history_value(project, mid, field, action, history, requested_entity=None, use_selection=True):
+    """Only typed matching owners qualify. Multiple objects remain ambiguous."""
+    norm = lambda value: re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', value.lower())
+    requested = set(requested_entity) if requested_entity else entity_words(field[:-4] if field.endswith('Name') else field)
+    if not requested:
+        route_entities = set()
+        names = {field, *(p['wire_name'] for p in project.http_parameters(mid) if p['name'] == field)}
+        for handler, _, route in project.ix.handlers:
+            if handler != mid:
+                continue
+            for index, segment in enumerate(route):
+                if segment.strip('{}').split(':', 1)[0] in names and index > 0:
+                    previous = route[index - 1]
+                    if not previous.startswith('{'):
+                        route_entities.add(tuple(sorted(entity_words(previous))))
+        requested = set(next(iter(route_entities))) if len(route_entities) == 1 else entity_words(project.nodes[project.methods[mid]['owner']]['fqn'])
+    candidates, by_step, creations = {}, {}, {}
+    for index, item in enumerate(history):
+        observed = [*objects(item.get('result', U), 'history[' + str(index) + '].result'),
+                    *objects(item.get('created_objects', []), 'history[' + str(index) + '].created_objects')]
+        for path, obj in observed:
+            owner = entity_words(obj['__type__'])
+            tid = project.resolve_type(obj['__type__'], project.methods[mid]['module'])
+            declared = project.type_fields.get(tid, {})
+            ids = [k for k, meta in declared.items() if meta.get('id')]
+            keys = [k for k in obj if norm(k) == norm(field)]
+            named_reference = norm(field).endswith('id') and norm(field) != 'id' and any(k in declared for k in keys)
+            if not named_reference and (not requested or not owner or not requested & owner):
+                continue
+            if norm(field) in ('key', 'id') and owner != requested:
+                continue
+            if not keys and owner == requested and (norm(field).endswith('id') or norm(field) in ('key', 'id')):
+                keys = ids
+            if not keys and owner == requested and field.endswith('Name') and 'name' in declared:
+                keys = ['name']
+            for key in keys:
+                value = obj.get(key, U)
+                if contains_unknown(value) or value is None:
+                    continue
+                rendered = source_string(project, value) if isinstance(value, dict) and '__symbol__' not in value else value
+                canonical = rendered if rendered is not U else value
+                identity = (tuple(sorted(owner)), repr(canonical))
+                candidates[identity] = (path + '.' + key, value, index)
+                by_step.setdefault(index, [])
+                if identity not in by_step[index]:
+                    by_step[index].append(identity)
+                if owner == requested and ('.created_objects' in path or re.search(r'\b(?:create|add|register|book|reserve|insert)\b', item.get('action', ''), re.I)):
+                    creations.setdefault(identity, index)
+    identities = list(candidates)
+    ordinal = ordinal_for(action, requested)
+    wants_new = new_for(action, requested)
+    if use_selection and not ordinal and not wants_new and (norm(field).endswith('id') or norm(field) in ('key', 'id')):
+        for index in range(len(history) - 1, -1, -1):
+            selected = history[index].get('selected_objects', [])
+            for position, item in enumerate(selected if isinstance(selected, list) else []):
+                if item.get('entity') == sorted(requested) and item.get('value', U) is not U and not contains_unknown(item['value']):
+                    return 'history[' + str(index) + '].selected_objects[' + str(position) + '].value', item['value']
+    if wants_new:
+        created = [key for key in identities if key in creations]
+        if not created:
+            return None
+        newest = max(creations[key] for key in created)
+        identities = sorted(created, key=lambda key: creations[key]) if ordinal else [key for key in created if creations[key] == newest]
+    elif ordinal:
+        # Use the latest collection's actual order, even after later single-object reads.
+        collections = [keys for keys in by_step.values() if len(keys) > 1]
+        if collections:
+            identities = collections[-1]
+    values = [candidates[key] for key in identities]
+    if ordinal and values:
+        ordered = values
+        position = ('first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth').index(ordinal[1].lower())
+        return ordered[position][:2] if position < len(ordered) else None
+    if len(values) == 1:
+        return values[0][:2]
+    return None
+
+
+def selected_field(project, field, params, history):
+    """A value from a selected object needs a matching identifier in this request."""
+    for index in range(len(history) - 1, -1, -1):
+        selected = history[index].get('selected_objects', [])
+        for position, item in enumerate(selected if isinstance(selected, list) else []):
+            obj = item.get('object', {})
+            tid = project.resolve_type(obj.get('__type__', ''), '') if isinstance(obj, dict) else None
+            if field not in project.type_fields.get(tid, {}):
+                continue
+            linked = any(entity_words(key) == set(item.get('entity', [])) and value == item.get('value') for key, value in params.items())
+            value = obj.get(field, U)
+            if linked and value is not U and not contains_unknown(value):
+                return 'history[' + str(index) + '].selected_objects[' + str(position) + '].object.' + field, value
+    return None
+
+
+def history_role_value(project, field, params, history):
+    """Carry role values only from an object whose declared ID matches this request."""
+    from .nl_inputs import field_role
+    role = field_role(field)
+    if role not in ('origin', 'destination', 'via') and field.lower() != 'date':
+        return None
+    identifiers = {key: value for key, value in params.items()
+                   if key.lower().endswith('id') and value is not U and value is not None}
+    if not identifiers:
+        return None
+    for index in range(len(history) - 1, -1, -1):
+        previous = history[index].get('parameters', {})
+        shared = identifiers.keys() & previous.keys()
+        if shared and all(previous[key] == identifiers[key] for key in shared):
+            values = [(key, value) for key, value in previous.items() if field_role(key) == role
+                      and value is not None and value is not U and not contains_unknown(value)]
+            if len({repr(value) for _, value in values}) == 1:
+                return 'history[' + str(index) + '].parameters.' + values[0][0], values[0][1]
+        matches = []
+        for path, obj in objects(history[index].get('result', U), 'history[' + str(index) + '].result'):
+            tid = project.resolve_type(obj['__type__'], '')
+            declared = project.type_fields.get(tid, {})
+            linked = False
+            for key, expected in identifiers.items():
+                value = obj.get(key, U) if key in declared else U
+                if isinstance(value, dict) and '__symbol__' not in value:
+                    value = source_string(project, value)
+                if value is not U and value == expected:
+                    linked = True
+            if not linked:
+                continue
+            for key in declared:
+                value = obj.get(key, U)
+                if field_role(key) == role and value is not U and value is not None and not contains_unknown(value):
+                    matches.append((path + '.' + key, value))
+        if matches:
+            return matches[0] if len({repr(value) for _, value in matches}) == 1 else None
+    return None

+"""Lower explicit filters through DTO mutators and source enum constants."""
+import re
+import calendar
+from datetime import datetime
+from baseline_nlp import ntoks
+from .project import text, walk
+from .provenance import entity_words
+from .state import U
+from .engine import Engine
+
+
+def generated_omissions(project, mid):
+    """Optional DTO identifiers whose null case generates a UUID in source."""
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_generated_input_fields', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    result = {}
+    roots = {project.resolve_type(p['type'], project.methods[mid]['module'], project.methods[mid]['file'])
+             for p in project.http_parameters(mid) if p['kind'] == 'RequestBody'} - {None}
+    reachable = project.__dict__.setdefault('_request_reachable', {})
+    if mid not in reachable:
+        reachable[mid] = project.ix.closure({mid})[0] | {mid}
+    for method in reachable[mid]:
+        node = project.ast.get(method)
+        if node is None or 'randomUUID' not in text(node):
+            continue
+        meta = project.methods[method]
+        names = {name for name, typ in project.parameters(method) if project.resolve_type(typ, meta['module'], meta['file']) in roots}
+        for condition in walk(node):
+            if condition.type != 'if_statement':
+                continue
+            test = condition.child_by_field_name('condition')
+            raw = text(test).strip('() ')
+            matched = re.fullmatch(r'(\w+)\.(?:get([A-Z]\w*)\(\)|(\w+))\s*(==|!=)\s*null', raw)
+            if not matched or matched[1] not in names:
+                continue
+            field = matched[2][:1].lower() + matched[2][1:] if matched[2] else matched[3]
+            branch = condition.child_by_field_name('consequence' if matched[4] == '==' else 'alternative')
+            if not branch or not re.search(r'\bUUID\s*\.\s*randomUUID\s*\(', text(branch)):
+                continue
+            read = matched[1] + '.' + ('get' + matched[2] + '()' if matched[2] else matched[3])
+            aliases = {text(local.child_by_field_name('name')) for local in walk(node)
+                       if local.type == 'variable_declarator' and local.start_byte < condition.start_byte
+                       and text(local.child_by_field_name('value')) == read}
+            assignments = [item for item in walk(branch) if item.type == 'assignment_expression'
+                           and (text(item.child_by_field_name('left')) in aliases
+                                or text(item.child_by_field_name('left')) == matched[1] + '.' + field)
+                           and re.search(r'\bUUID\s*\.\s*randomUUID\s*\(', text(item.child_by_field_name('right')))]
+            if not assignments:
+                continue
+            if project.resolve_type('UUID', meta['module'], meta['file']) is not None:
+                continue
+            if 'java.util.UUID' not in project.sources[meta['file']].decode() and 'java.util.*' not in project.sources[meta['file']].decode():
+                continue
+            if any(field in project.type_fields.get(root, {}) and project.type_fields[root][field]['type'].split('.')[-1] in ('String', 'UUID') for root in roots):
+                result[field] = method + ':' + str(condition.start_point.row + 1)
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def enum_scalar_binding(project, mid, field, action):
+    """Use an enum's numeric value only when source compares this input getter to it."""
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_input_enum_evidence', {})
+    cache_key = (mid, field)
+    if cache_key not in cache:
+        reachable = project.__dict__.setdefault('_request_reachable', {})
+        if mid not in reachable:
+            reachable[mid] = project.ix.closure({mid})[0] | {mid}
+        getter = 'get' + field[:1].upper() + field[1:]
+        evidence = []
+        for method in reachable[mid]:
+            node = project.ast.get(method)
+            if node is None or getter not in text(node):
+                continue
+            for condition in walk(node):
+                if condition.type != 'binary_expression' or not re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(getter) + r'\s*\(', text(condition)):
+                    continue
+                source = text(condition)
+                owners = {name.rsplit('.', 1)[0] for name in project.enum_objects
+                          if re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(name.rsplit('.', 1)[0].split('.')[-1]) + r'\s*\.\s*'
+                                       + re.escape(name.rsplit('.', 1)[1]) + r'\b', source)}
+                for name, obj in project.enum_objects.items():
+                    owner, member_name = name.rsplit('.', 1)
+                    if owner in owners:
+                        values = [v for key, v in obj.items() if not key.startswith('__') and isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)]
+                        if len(values) == 1:
+                            labels = [member_name, *(v for key, v in obj.items() if not key.startswith('__') and isinstance(v, str))]
+                            evidence.append((values[0], name, labels, method))
+        cache[cache_key] = evidence
+    normalized = lambda s: re.sub('[^a-z0-9]', '', s.lower())
+    matches = [(value, name, method) for value, name, labels, method in cache[cache_key]
+               if any(len(normalized(label)) >= 4 and normalized(label) in normalized(action) for label in labels)]
+    if len({repr(value) for value, _, _ in matches}) == 1:
+        return matches[0]
+    return None
+
+
+def partial_url_parameters(frontend, mid, site, state):
+    """Keep known path/query parts even when another expression is unknown."""
+    expression = site['url']
+    tree = frontend.parser.parse(('(' + expression + ');').encode())
+    marker = '__unresolved_browser_value__'
+    while marker in expression:
+        marker += '_'
+
+    def render(node):
+        if node is None:
+            return marker
+        if node.type in ('parenthesized_expression', 'expression_statement') and node.named_children:
+            return render(node.named_children[0])
+        if node.type == 'binary_expression' and text(node.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '+':
+            return render(node.child_by_field_name('left')) + render(node.child_by_field_name('right'))
+        value = frontend.evaluate(text(node), state, definitions=site['definitions'])
+        return str(value) if isinstance(value, (str, int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool) else marker
+
+    url = render(tree.root_node.named_children[0])
+    values = Engine(frontend.project, state).path_parameters(mid, url)
+    return {key: value for key, value in values.items() if not isinstance(value, str) or marker not in value}
+
+
+def date_interval(phrase, clock=None):
+    if re.search(r'\btoday\b', phrase, re.I) and isinstance(clock, datetime):
+        return clock.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0), clock.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0)
+    months = {name.lower(): index for index, name in enumerate(calendar.month_name) if name}
+    names = '|'.join(months)
+    found = re.search(r'\b(' + names + r')\s*(?:[—–-]|through|to)\s*(' + names + r')\s+(\d{4})\b', phrase, re.I)
+    if found:
+        start, end, year = months[found[1].lower()], months[found[2].lower()], int(found[3])
+        if start <= end:
+            return datetime(year, start, 1), datetime(year, end, calendar.monthrange(year, end)[1], 23, 59, 59)
+    return None
+
+
+def filter_bindings(project, mid, action, clock=None):
+    match = re.search(r'\bfilter(?:ed)?\b(?:\s+by)?\s+(.*)', action, re.I)
+    if not match:
+        return []
+    phrase = match[1]
+    canonical = lambda word: {'bought': 'purchase', 'buy': 'purchase', 'statu': 'state', 'status': 'state'}.get(word, word)
+    words = {canonical(word) for word in ntoks(phrase)}
+    interval = date_interval(phrase, clock)
+    output = []
+    for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
+        if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
+            continue
+        tid = project.resolve_type(parameter['type'], project.methods[mid]['module'])
+        fields = project.type_fields.get(tid, {})
+        entity = entity_words(parameter['type'])
+        candidates = []
+        for method, meta in project.methods.items():
+            if meta['owner'] != tid or meta['name'] == '<init>':
+                continue
+            node = project.ast.get(method)
+            body = node.child_by_field_name('body') if node else None
+            statements = [c for c in body.named_children if c.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if body else []
+            if not statements or any(s.type != 'expression_statement' for s in statements):
+                continue
+            assignments = []
+            for statement in statements:
+                expression = statement.named_children[0]
+                if expression.type != 'assignment_expression' or text(expression.child_by_field_name('operator')) != '=':
+                    break
+                lhs = text(expression.child_by_field_name('left')).removeprefix('this.')
+                rhs = text(expression.child_by_field_name('right'))
+                if lhs not in fields:
+                    break
+                assignments.append((lhs, rhs))
+            else:
+                if not any(rhs == 'true' and fields[key]['type'] == 'boolean' for key, rhs in assignments):
+                    continue
+                params = dict(project.parameters(method))
+                concepts = (set(ntoks(meta['name'] + ' ' + ' '.join(params)))
+                            - {'enable', 'query', 'filter', 'target', 'start', 'end', 'time'})
+                concepts = {canonical(word) for word in concepts}
+                if not concepts & words:
+                    continue
+                bindings = []
+                for key, rhs in assignments:
+                    value, reference = U, method
+                    if rhs in ('true', 'false'):
+                        value = rhs == 'true'
+                    elif rhs in params:
+                        constants = []
+                        for name, obj in project.enum_objects.items():
+                            owner, member = name.rsplit('.', 1)
+                            label = set(ntoks(member))
+                            owner_words = {canonical(word) for word in ntoks(owner)}
+                            if not label or not label <= words or not owner_words & concepts or (entity and not owner_words & entity):
+                                continue
+                            scalars = [v for k, v in obj.items() if not k.startswith('__') and isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)]
+                            if len(scalars) == 1:
+                                constants.append((scalars[0], name))
+                        if len({repr(v) for v, _ in constants}) == 1:
+                            value, reference = constants[0]
+                        elif interval and 'date' in concepts:
+                            boundary = set(ntoks(rhs))
+                            endpoint = interval[0] if 'start' in boundary else interval[1] if 'end' in boundary else None
+                            if endpoint is not None:
+                                value = Engine.coerce(endpoint.isoformat(sep=' '), params[rhs])
+                                if re.search(r'\btoday\b', phrase, re.I):
+                                    reference += ':context.clock'
+                    bindings.append((key, value, reference, match[0]))
+                candidates.append((len(concepts & words), bindings))
+        if candidates:
+            best = max(score for score, _ in candidates)
+            candidates = [bindings for score, bindings in candidates if score == best]
+        if len(candidates) == 1:
+            output.extend(candidates[0])
+        elif len(candidates) > 1:
+            ambiguous = {key: (key, U, reference, quote) for candidate in candidates
+                         for key, _, reference, quote in candidate}
+            output.extend(ambiguous.values())
+    return output

+"""Explicit structured literals, restricted by declared source input fields."""
+import re
+
+from .nl_inputs import field_role, words
+from .project import text, walk
+from .provenance import entity_words
+from .state import U
+from .structured_literals import literal_value
+
+
+def csv_fields(project, mid):
+    """Only fields split by a literal delimiter inside their declaring DTO."""
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_csv_inputs', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    roots = {project.resolve_type(p['type'], project.methods[mid]['module'], project.methods[mid]['file'])
+             for p in project.http_parameters(mid) if p['kind'] == 'RequestBody'} - {None}
+    result = {}
+    for method, meta in project.methods.items():
+        if meta['owner'] not in roots or method not in project.ast:
+            continue
+        for call in walk(project.ast[method]):
+            if call.type != 'method_invocation' or text(call.child_by_field_name('name')) != 'split':
+                continue
+            receiver = call.child_by_field_name('object')
+            field = text(receiver).removeprefix('this.')
+            args = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+            if field not in project.type_fields[meta['owner']] or args is None or len(args.named_children) != 1:
+                continue
+            if text(args.named_children[0]) != '\",\"':
+                continue
+            alias = meta['name'][3:] if meta['name'].startswith('get') else ''
+            result[field] = {'delimiter': ',', 'label': alias, 'reference': method + ':' + str(call.start_point.row + 1)}
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def field_labels(fields, field):
+    """A unique ordered field-name projection may omit one interior word."""
+    split = lambda name: re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+', name)
+    parts = split(field)
+    labels = []
+    for index in range(1, len(parts) - 1):
+        candidate = [part.lower() for part in parts[:index] + parts[index + 1:]]
+        owners = [name for name in fields if set(candidate) <= {part.lower() for part in split(name)}]
+        if owners == [field]:
+            labels.append(' '.join(candidate))
+    return labels
+
+
+def explicit_chain(project, mid, action):
+    candidates = re.findall(r'\(([^()]*?(?:—|–|→|->)[^()]*)\)', action)
+    for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
+        if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
+            continue
+        label = re.sub(r'(?:Request|Dto|Info|Input)$', '', parameter['type'].split('.')[-1])
+        parts = re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+', label)
+        phrase = r'[ _-]*'.join(map(re.escape, parts))
+        if not phrase:
+            continue
+        found = re.search(r'\b' + phrase + r'\b\s+([^,;()]+?)(?=\s+(?:with|for|on)\b|$)', action, re.I)
+        if found and re.search(r'—|–|→|->', found[1]):
+            candidates.append(found[1])
+    paths = {tuple(part.strip() for part in re.split(r'\s*(?:—|–|→|->)\s*', candidate)) for candidate in candidates}
+    paths = [path for path in paths if len(path) >= 2 and all(re.fullmatch(r'[\w][\w .\'-]*', part) for part in path)]
+    return paths[0] if len(paths) == 1 else None
+
+
+def boolean_wire_fields(project, mid):
+    """String parameters converted through java.lang.Boolean.parseBoolean."""
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_boolean_wire_fields', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    result = {}
+    node = project.ast.get(mid)
+    meta = project.methods[mid]
+    for call in walk(node) if node is not None else []:
+        if call.type != 'method_invocation' or text(call.child_by_field_name('name')) != 'parseBoolean':
+            continue
+        receiver = text(call.child_by_field_name('object'))
+        if receiver not in ('Boolean', 'java.lang.Boolean') or receiver == 'Boolean' and project.resolve_type('Boolean', meta['module'], meta['file']) is not None:
+            continue
+        args = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+        if args is not None and len(args.named_children) == 1 and args.named_children[0].type == 'identifier':
+            result[text(args.named_children[0])] = mid + ':' + str(call.start_point.row + 1)
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def structured_bindings(project, mid, action):
+    fields = project.request_fields(mid)
+    output = {}
+    for field, typ in fields.items():
+        value, quote = literal_value(action, field, typ, field_labels(fields, field))
+        if value is not U:
+            output[field] = (value, 'action:declared-field-label', quote)
+        if typ.split('.')[-1] != 'String' or 'time' not in words(field):
+            continue
+        role = words(field)
+        label = r'(?:depart(?:ing|ure)?|start(?:\s+time)?)' if role & {'start', 'departure'} else r'(?:arriv(?:ing|al|e)|end(?:\s+time)?)' if role & {'end', 'arrival'} else None
+        matches = list(re.finditer(r'\b' + label + r'\s+(?:at\s+)?((?:[01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d)\b', action, re.I)) if label else []
+        if len({match[1] for match in matches}) == 1:
+            output[field] = (matches[0][1], 'action:time-role-from-field', matches[0][0])
+    collections = csv_fields(project, mid)
+    for field, reference in boolean_wire_fields(project, mid).items():
+        if fields.get(field, '').split('.')[-1] != 'String':
+            continue
+        parts = re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+', field)
+        if parts and parts[0].lower() in ('is', 'has'):
+            parts = parts[1:]
+        if not parts:
+            continue
+        phrase = r'\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?'.join(map(re.escape, parts))
+        matches = list(re.finditer(r'\b' + phrase + r'\b', action, re.I))
+        values = {not bool(re.search(r'\b(?:no|not|without)\s*$', action[:match.start()], re.I)) for match in matches}
+        if len(values) == 1:
+            output[field] = ('true' if next(iter(values)) else 'false', reference, matches[0][0])
+    for field, meta in collections.items():
+        for typ in ('List<Integer>', 'List<Double>'):
+            value, quote = literal_value(action, field, typ, (meta['label'],))
+            if value is not U:
+                output[field] = (','.join(map(str, value)), meta['reference'], quote)
+                break
+    chain = explicit_chain(project, mid, action)
+    if chain:
+        roles = {}
+        for role in ('origin', 'destination', 'via'):
+            matching = [field for field in fields if field_role(field) == role]
+            if len(matching) == 1:
+                roles[role] = matching[0]
+        for role, value in [('origin', chain[0]), ('destination', chain[-1]), ('via', chain[1] if len(chain) == 3 else U)]:
+            if role in roles and value is not U:
+                output[roles[role]] = (value, 'action:explicit-chain', action)
+        if 'origin' in roles and 'destination' in roles:
+            shared = entity_words(roles['origin']) & entity_words(roles['destination'])
+            shared -= {'start', 'end', 'source', 'destination', 'terminal', 'origin', 'name'}
+            matching = [field for field, meta in collections.items() if shared & entity_words(meta['label'])]
+            if len(matching) == 1:
+                field = matching[0]
+                output[field] = (','.join(chain), collections[field]['reference'], action)
+    return output

+"""Explicit selection language links later requests to source-typed objects."""
+from copy import deepcopy
+import re
+
+from baseline_nlp import ntoks
+from .provenance import objects, entity_words, history_value, contains_unknown, source_string
+from .state import U
+
+
+def selected_objects(project, mid, action, history):
+    if not re.search(r'^(?:open|select|choose|take|inspect)\b|\band\s+take\b', action, re.I):
+        return []
+    focus = re.split(r'\b(?:for|with|without|from|on|onto)\b', action, 1, flags=re.I)[0]
+    words = set(ntoks(focus))
+    observed = []
+    for index, item in enumerate(history):
+        for name in ('result', 'created_objects'):
+            observed.extend(objects(item.get(name, U), 'history[' + str(index) + '].' + name))
+    groups = {tuple(sorted(entity_words(obj['__type__']))) for _, obj in observed
+              if entity_words(obj['__type__']) and entity_words(obj['__type__']) <= words}
+    fields = project.request_fields(mid)
+    output = []
+    for entity in sorted(groups):
+        named = [key for key in fields if key.lower().endswith('id') and entity_words(key) == set(entity)]
+        field = named[0] if len(named) == 1 else 'id'
+        reference = history_value(project, mid, field, action, history, entity, use_selection=False)
+        if reference is None:
+            continue
+        parent = reference[0].rsplit('.', 1)[0]
+        obj = next((obj for path, obj in observed if path == parent), None)
+        if obj is not None and not contains_unknown(reference[1]):
+            value = source_string(project, reference[1]) if isinstance(reference[1], dict) and '__symbol__' not in reference[1] else reference[1]
+            if value is not U:
+                output.append({'entity': list(entity), 'value': deepcopy(value),
+                               'reference': reference[0], 'object': deepcopy(obj)})
+    return output

+"""Local aliases for request DTO fields, proven by getter chains in source.
+
+For a handler mid, field_aliases() takes the declared @RequestBody types and
+reports which local variable names are directly initialized (or directly
+assigned) from a zero-argument getter whose receiver resolves to exactly one
+of those DTO types. The getter suffix must match a field actually declared by
+that DTO type (getFoo -> foo). Only the full local name and method:line
+evidence are recorded: no input values, synonyms or semantic equivalents are
+invented, and unresolved types or receivers contribute no facts.
+"""
+import re
+
+from .project import text, walk
+
+
+def _getter_field(name):
+    return name[3].lower() + name[4:] if re.fullmatch(r'get[A-Z]\w*', name) else None
+
+
+def _arguments(invocation):
+    arguments = invocation.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+    return [child for child in arguments.named_children
+            if child.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if arguments else []
+
+
+def _declared(project, tid):
+    return project.type_fields.get(tid, {})
+
+
+def _scope(project, mid):
+    """Identifier -> (written type, file); plus names bound as parameters or locals."""
+    node = project.ast.get(mid)
+    if node is None:
+        return {}, set()
+    method = project.methods[mid]
+    scope, bindings = {}, set()
+    for name, field in project.type_fields.get(method['owner'], {}).items():
+        scope[name] = (field['type'], field['file'])
+    parameters = node.child_by_field_name('parameters')
+    for parameter in parameters.named_children if parameters else []:
+        if parameter.type == 'formal_parameter':
+            name = text(parameter.child_by_field_name('name'))
+            scope[name] = (text(parameter.child_by_field_name('type')), method['file'])
+            bindings.add(name)
+    for declaration in walk(node):
+        if declaration.type != 'local_variable_declaration':
+            continue
+        written = text(declaration.child_by_field_name('type'))
+        for variable in declaration.named_children:
+            if variable.type == 'variable_declarator':
+                name = text(variable.child_by_field_name('name'))
+                scope[name] = (written, method['file'])
+                bindings.add(name)
+    return scope, bindings
+
+
+def _expr_type(project, expression, scope, module, file, owner):
+    """Type id for an identifier, this, field access or zero-arg declared getter."""
+    if expression is None:
+        return None
+    if expression.type == 'identifier':
+        entry = scope.get(text(expression))
+        return project.resolve_type(entry[0], module, entry[1]) if entry else None
+    if expression.type == 'this':
+        return owner
+    if expression.type == 'field_access':
+        base = _expr_type(project, expression.child_by_field_name('object'), scope, module, file, owner)
+        field = _declared(project, base).get(text(expression.child_by_field_name('field')))
+        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
+    if expression.type == 'method_invocation':
+        if _arguments(expression):
+            return None
+        name = _getter_field(text(expression.child_by_field_name('name')))
+        receiver = expression.child_by_field_name('object')
+        base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
+        field = _declared(project, base).get(name) if name else None
+        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
+    return None
+
+
+def _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, module, file, owner):
+    """Declared root DTO field read by a direct zero-arg getter value, else None."""
+    if value is None or value.type != 'method_invocation' or _arguments(value):
+        return None
+    field = _getter_field(text(value.child_by_field_name('name')))
+    receiver = value.child_by_field_name('object')
+    base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
+    return field if field and base in roots and field in _declared(project, base) else None
+
+
+def _scan(project, roots):
+    found = []
+    for mid in sorted(project.methods):
+        node = project.ast.get(mid)
+        if node is None:
+            continue
+        method = project.methods[mid]
+        scope, bindings = _scope(project, mid)
+        for statement in walk(node):
+            pairs = []
+            if statement.type == 'local_variable_declaration':
+                pairs = [(text(variable.child_by_field_name('name')), variable.child_by_field_name('value'))
+                         for variable in statement.named_children if variable.type == 'variable_declarator']
+            elif statement.type == 'assignment_expression' and text(statement.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '=':
+                left = statement.child_by_field_name('left')
+                if left.type == 'identifier' and text(left) in bindings:
+                    pairs = [(text(left), statement.child_by_field_name('right'))]
+            for label, value in pairs:
+                field = _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, method['module'], method['file'], method['owner'])
+                if field:
+                    found.append((field, label, mid, statement.start_point.row + 1))
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(found))
+
+
+def field_aliases(project, mid):
+    """Field aliases for the @RequestBody declared types of mid.
+
+    Returns {field: [{'label': local name, 'reference': 'source_mid:line'}]}.
+    Every indexed source method is scanned for direct getter-chain evidence;
+    the scan is shared between calls with the same root type set and results
+    are cached per mid. Fields without proven aliases are omitted.
+    """
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_cache', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    method = project.methods.get(mid)
+    roots = set()
+    if method:
+        for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
+            if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
+                continue
+            tid = project.resolve_type(parameter['type'], method['module'], method['file'])
+            if project.type_fields.get(tid):
+                roots.add(tid)
+    result = {}
+    if roots:
+        scans = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_scan', {})
+        key = tuple(sorted(roots))
+        if key not in scans:
+            scans[key] = _scan(project, roots)
+        for field, label, source, line in scans[key]:
+            result.setdefault(field, []).append({'label': label, 'reference': f'{source}:{line}'})
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result

+"""Read a MySQL dump as text, retaining independent state for each scenario."""
+from copy import deepcopy
+from enum import Enum
+import gzip
+import re
+
+
+class Unknown(Enum):
+    VALUE = 'unknown'
+
+
+U = Unknown.VALUE
+
+
+class JavaScriptValue(Enum):
+    UNDEFINED = 'javascript undefined'
+
+
+JS_UNDEFINED = JavaScriptValue.UNDEFINED
+
+
+def camel(name):
+    return re.sub(r'_([a-z])', lambda m: m[1].upper(), name)
+
+
+def sql_rows(source):
+    """Tokenize the dump's VALUES tuples, including escaped quotes and commas."""
+    token, row, quoted, escaped, quoted_value = '', [], False, False, False
+    for char in source:
+        if escaped:
+            token += {'n': '\n', 'r': '\r', 't': '\t', '0': '\0'}.get(char, char)
+            escaped = False
+        elif quoted:
+            if char == '\\':
+                escaped = True
+            elif char == "'":
+                quoted = False
+            else:
+                token += char
+        elif char == "'":
+            quoted = quoted_value = True
+        elif char in ',)':
+            if token.strip() or quoted_value:
+                value = token if quoted_value else token.strip()
+                if not quoted_value:
+                    if value == 'NULL':
+                        value = None
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+', value):
+                        value = int(value)
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+\.\d+', value):
+                        value = float(value)
+                row.append(value)
+                token, quoted_value = '', False
+            if char == ')':
+                yield row
+                row = []
+        elif char not in '(':
+            token += char
+
+
+class Database:
+    def __init__(self, path):
+        self.tables = {}
+        self.schemas = {}
+        self.unknown_tables = set()
+        db = None
+        opener = gzip.open if str(path).endswith('.gz') else open
+        with opener(path, 'rt', encoding='utf-8', errors='surrogateescape') as stream:
+            content = stream.read()
+        columns = {}
+        for statement in re.finditer(r'USE `([^`]+)`;|CREATE TABLE `([^`]+)` \((.*?)\) ENGINE|INSERT INTO `([^`]+)` VALUES (.*?);\s*(?:\n|$)', content, re.S):
+            use, create, fields, insert, values = statement.groups()
+            if use:
+                db = use
+            elif create:
+                columns[(db, create)] = re.findall(r'^\s*`([^`]+)`', fields, re.M)
+                self.tables[(db, create)] = []
+            elif insert:
+                names = columns[(db, insert)]
+                for row in sql_rows(values):
+                    if len(row) != len(names):
+                        raise ValueError(f'Dump row length mismatch: {db}.{insert}')
+                    self.tables[(db, insert)].append({camel(k): v for k, v in zip(names, row)})
+
+    def materialize(self, resource, row, aliases=None, collections=None, primary_field=None):
+        record = deepcopy(row)
+        for column, field in (aliases or {}).items():
+            if column in record and field not in record:
+                record[field] = record[column]
+        db = self.schemas.get(resource.get('schema', ''), resource.get('schema', ''))
+        if (db, resource['name']) not in self.tables:
+            candidates = [schema for schema, table in self.tables if table == resource['name']]
+            if len(candidates) == 1:
+                db = candidates[0]
+        for prop, table, foreign, *columns in collections or []:
+            if prop not in record:
+                norm = lambda value: re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', value.lower())
+                def get(row, column):
+                    return next((value for key, value in row.items() if norm(key) == norm(column)), U)
+                rows = self.tables.get((db, table))
+                if rows is None or (db, table) in self.unknown_tables:
+                    record[prop] = U
+                    continue
+                if not primary_field or record.get(primary_field, U) in (U, None) or any(get(r, foreign) is U for r in rows):
+                    record[prop] = U
+                    continue
+                selected = [r for r in rows if primary_field and get(r, foreign) == record.get(primary_field)]
+                if columns:
+                    value_column, order_column = columns
+                    if order_column:
+                        positions = [get(r, order_column) for r in selected]
+                        if (any(not isinstance(index, int) or isinstance(index, bool) for index in positions)
+                                or sorted(positions) != list(range(len(positions)))):
+                            record[prop] = U
+                            continue
+                        selected = sorted(selected, key=lambda r: get(r, order_column))
+                    record[prop] = [get(r, value_column) for r in selected]
+                else:
+                    record[prop] = [{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != foreign} for r in selected]
+        return record
+
+    def copy(self):
+        return deepcopy(self)
+
+    def invalidate(self, rows):
+        for key, existing in self.tables.items():
+            if existing is rows:
+                self.unknown_tables.add(key)
+
+    def rows(self, resource):
+        schema = resource.get('schema', '')
+        db = self.schemas.get(schema, schema)
+        key = (db, resource['name'])
+        if key in self.unknown_tables:
+            return None
+        if key in self.tables:
+            return self.tables[key]
+        matches = [(key, rows) for key, rows in self.tables.items() if key[1] == resource['name']]
+        return matches[0][1] if len(matches) == 1 and matches[0][0] not in self.unknown_tables else None
+
+    def summary(self):
+        return {db + '.' + table: len(rows) for (db, table), rows in sorted(self.tables.items())}
+
+
+class ScenarioState:
+    """Generic path-local database, browser state and response journal."""
+    def __init__(self, database, context=None):
+        self.database = database.copy()
+        self.context = deepcopy(context or {})
+        self.now = self.context.get('clock', U)
+        self.browser = {'storage': {}, 'form': {}, 'dom': {}, 'url': {}}
+        self.history = []
+        self.symbol_sequence = 0
+        self.input_sequence = 0
+        self.limitations = []
+
+    def fresh_input(self, label, typ='String'):
+        existing = {str(v) for rows in self.database.tables.values() for row in rows for v in row.values()}
+        normalized = lambda name: re.sub('[^a-z0-9]', '', name.lower())
+        related = [value for rows in self.database.tables.values() for row in rows for name, value in row.items()
+                   if normalized(name) == normalized(label)]
+        excluded = list(dict.fromkeys(value for value in related if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool))))
+        symbols = [value['__symbol__'] for value in related if isinstance(value, dict) and '__symbol__' in value]
+        while True:
+            self.input_sequence += 1
+            value = 'symbolic-input-' + label + '-' + str(self.input_sequence)
+            if value not in existing:
+                return {'__symbol__': value, '__type__': typ, '__constraints__': ['non_null', 'fresh_unique'],
+                        '__distinct_from__': excluded, '__distinct_symbols__': symbols}
+
+    def snapshot(self):
+        return {'browser': deepcopy(self.browser),
+                'history': [{k: item.get(k) for k in ('step', 'entry', 'action')} for item in self.history],
+                'clock': self.now, 'database_rows': self.database.summary(),
+                'limitations': list(self.limitations)}

+"""Explicit field-labelled numeric scalars and numeric sequences only.
+
+A value must directly follow a boundary-anchored field label (the camel/snake
+split of the field name plus caller-supplied source labels), optionally
+through is/of/=/:, and must be a whole finite numeric token. Lists require a
+declared List<Integer>/List<Double> or int[]/double[] type and labelled
+syntax. Repeated labelled occurrences must all parse to one value; a
+malformed occurrence, invalid element or dangling separator yields U.
+Nothing else is parsed: no times, no strings, no roles, no alias dictionaries.
+"""
+import math
+import re
+
+from .state import U
+
+_INT = ('int', 'Integer', 'long', 'Long', 'short', 'Short', 'byte', 'Byte')
+_FLOAT = ('double', 'Double', 'float', 'Float')
+_STOP = re.compile(r';|\s+(?:with|for|from)\b', re.I)
+_CONNECTOR = r'\s*(?:is|of|=|:)?\s*'
+_NUMBER = {'int': r'-?\d+', 'double': r'-?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)'}
+
+
+def _words(value):
+    split = re.sub(r'([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', r'\1 \2', str(value))
+    return re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+|\d+', split)
+
+
+def _kind(name):
+    name = name.split('.')[-1].strip()
+    if name in _INT:
+        return 'int'
+    return 'double' if name in _FLOAT else None
+
+
+def _sequence(typ):
+    text = typ.strip()
+    match = re.fullmatch(r'([\w.]+)\s*<\s*([\w.]+)\s*>', text)
+    if match and match[1].split('.')[-1] == 'List':
+        return _kind(match[2])
+    return _kind(text[:-2]) if text.endswith('[]') else None
+
+
+def _number(text, kind):
+    try:
+        value = int(text) if kind == 'int' else float(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    return value if kind == 'int' or math.isfinite(value) else None
+
+
+def _elements(region, kind):
+    parts = [part.strip() for part in region.split(',')]
+    if parts[-1]:
+        parts = parts[:-1] + [part.strip() for part in re.split(r'\s+and\s+', parts[-1], flags=re.I)]
+    parts = [re.sub(r'^and\s+', '', part, flags=re.I) for part in parts]
+    if any(not re.fullmatch(_NUMBER[kind], part) for part in parts):
+        return None
+    values = [_number(part, kind) for part in parts]
+    return None if any(value is None for value in values) else values
+
+
+def _occurrences(matches):
+    """One entry per distinct label span; a span contained in another is a duplicate."""
+    spans = {}
+    for match in matches:
+        spans.setdefault((match.start(), match.end()), match)
+    return [match for span, match in sorted(spans.items())
+            if not any(other != span and other[0] <= span[0] and span[1] <= other[1] for other in spans)]
+
+
+def literal_value(action, field, typ, labels=()):
+    """Return (value, exact quote) for explicit labelled numbers, else (U, '')."""
+    if isinstance(labels, str):
+        labels = (labels,)
+    sequence = _sequence(typ)
+    kind = sequence or _kind(typ)
+    if kind is None:
+        return U, ''
+    matches = []
+    for phrase in [str(field)] + [str(label) for label in labels if str(label).strip()]:
+        words = _words(phrase)
+        if words:
+            label = r'\b' + r'[ _-]*'.join(re.escape(word) for word in words) + r'\b' + _CONNECTOR
+            matches += list(re.finditer(label, action, re.I))
+    matches = _occurrences(matches)
+    found = {}
+    for index, match in enumerate(matches):
+        room = action[match.end():]
+        if index + 1 < len(matches):
+            room = re.sub(r'\s+and\s*$', '', room[:max(0, matches[index + 1].start() - match.end())], flags=re.I)
+        if sequence:
+            raw = _STOP.split(room, 1)[0]
+            region = raw.strip()
+            value = _elements(region, kind) if region else None
+            end = match.end() + raw.index(region) + len(region) if region else match.end()
+        else:
+            token = re.match(_NUMBER[kind] + r'(?![\w.:-])', room)
+            value = None if token is None else _number(token[0], kind)
+            end = match.end() + token.end() if token else match.end()
+        if value is None:
+            return U, ''
+        found.setdefault(repr(value), (value, action[match.start():end]))
+    return next(iter(found.values())) if len(found) == 1 else (U, '')

+"""Generic skeleton indexes and lexical retrieval."""
+import re, math, json, gzip, collections, warnings
+
+
+def load_json(path):
+    with (gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8") if path.endswith(".gz") else open(path, encoding="utf-8")) as fh:
+        return json.load(fh)
+
+
+def path_segs(p):
+    return [s for s in re.split(r"[/]+", p.split("?")[0]) if s]
+
+
+def match(req, tpl):
+    """Сегменты запроса против шаблона Spring: {x} — один сегмент, ** — хвост."""
+    if not tpl:
+        return not req
+    t = tpl[0]
+    if t == "**":
+        return True
+    if not req:
+        return False
+    if t.startswith("{") or t == "*" or t == req[0]:
+        return match(req[1:], tpl[1:])
+    return False
+
+
+def path_priority(template):
+    """Spring MVC specificity for the supported segment-pattern subset."""
+    variables = sum(part.startswith('{') for part in template)
+    wildcards = sum(part == '*' for part in template)
+    catchalls = sum(part == '**' or part.startswith('{*') for part in template)
+    length = sum(1 if part.startswith('{') else len(part) for part in template) + len(template)
+    return (-bool(catchalls), -variables - wildcards - 2 * catchalls, length, variables - wildcards)
+
+
+_SPRING_MAPPINGS = {"RequestMapping": None, "GetMapping": "GET", "PostMapping": "POST",
+                    "PutMapping": "PUT", "PatchMapping": "PATCH", "DeleteMapping": "DELETE"}
+
+
+class RouteWarning(UserWarning):
+    """Маршрут аннотации не удалось разобрать: путь не литерал."""
+
+
+def _split_args(s):
+    """Аргументы аннотации: деление по запятым верхнего уровня вне кавычек и скобок."""
+    s = (s or "").strip()
+    if s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")"):
+        s = s[1:-1]
+    parts, buf, depth, q, esc = [], [], 0, "", False
+    for ch in s:
+        if q:
+            buf.append(ch)
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif ch == q:
+                q = ""
+        elif ch in "\"'":
+            q = ch; buf.append(ch)
+        elif ch in "([{":
+            depth += 1; buf.append(ch)
+        elif ch in ")]}":
+            depth -= 1; buf.append(ch)
+        elif ch == "," and depth == 0:
+            parts.append("".join(buf).strip()); buf = []
+        else:
+            buf.append(ch)
+    if buf:
+        parts.append("".join(buf).strip())
+    return [p for p in parts if p]
+
+
+_LIT = r'"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"'
+_CONCAT = re.compile(r"\s*{0}(?:\s*\+\s*{0})*\s*".format(_LIT))
+_HTTP_METHODS = {"GET", "HEAD", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS", "TRACE"}
+
+
+def _literal(expr):
+    """Строковый литерал или чистая конкатенация литералов -> значение; иначе None."""
+    if not _CONCAT.fullmatch(expr):
+        return None
+    vals = []
+    for tok in re.findall(_LIT, expr):
+        try:
+            vals.append(json.loads(tok))
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return "".join(vals)
+
+
+def _path_values(expr, a):
+    """Пути value/path: литерал/массив литералов; пустой массив — [""], иначе None при неразрешимости."""
+    s = expr.strip()
+    if s.startswith("{") and s.endswith("}"):
+        comps = _split_args(s[1:-1])
+        if not comps:
+            return [""]
+        vals = []
+        for c in comps:
+            v = _literal(c)
+            if v is None:
+                warnings.warn("неразрешённый элемент пути в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], c), RouteWarning)
+            else:
+                vals.append(v)
+        return vals or None
+    v = _literal(s)
+    if v is None:
+        warnings.warn("не литеральный путь в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], expr), RouteWarning)
+    return [v] if v is not None else None
+
+
+def _method_verb(expr):
+    """RequestMethod.X (возможно полное имя) или стандартная константа -> HTTP-метод; иначе None."""
+    s = expr.strip()
+    m = re.fullmatch(r"(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\.\s*)*RequestMethod\s*\.\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)", s) or re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)", s)
+    return m.group(1) if m and m.group(1) in _HTTP_METHODS else None
+
+
+def _method_values(expr, a):
+    """Методы method=...: константа/массив; пустой массив — без ограничения, None — неразрешено."""
+    s = expr.strip()
+    if s.startswith("{") and s.endswith("}"):
+        comps = _split_args(s[1:-1])
+        if not comps:
+            return ["REQUEST"]
+        vals = []
+        for c in comps:
+            v = _method_verb(c)
+            if v is None:
+                warnings.warn("неразрешённый метод в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], c), RouteWarning)
+            else:
+                vals.append(v)
+        return vals or None
+    v = _method_verb(s)
+    if v is None:
+        warnings.warn("неразрешённый метод в аннотации %s: %s" % (a["name"], expr), RouteWarning)
+        return None
+    return [v]
+
+
+def ann_paths(anns):
+    """Маршруты Spring: только value/path (литерал или массив); method=RequestMethod.X — по tuple на метод."""
+    out = []
+    for a in anns or []:
+        base = a["name"].rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
+        if base not in _SPRING_MAPPINGS:
+            continue
+        paths, verbs, bad = None, None, False
+        for i, part in enumerate(_split_args(a.get("args") or "")):
+            m = re.match(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(.*)$", part, re.S)
+            name, expr = (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else (None, part)
+            if name in ("value", "path") or (name is None and i == 0):
+                paths = _path_values(expr, a)
+                bad = bad or paths is None
+            elif name == "method":
+                verbs = _method_values(expr, a)
+                bad = bad or verbs is None
+        if bad:
+            continue
+        if paths is None:
+            paths = [""]
+        fixed = _SPRING_MAPPINGS[base]
+        if fixed:
+            verbs = [fixed]
+        elif verbs is None:
+            verbs = ["REQUEST"]
+        for v in verbs:
+            out.append((v, list(paths)))
+    return out
+
+
+def toks(t):
+    return [w.lower() for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z][a-z0-9]+|[A-Z]+(?![a-z])", re.sub(r"([a-z])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", t or "")) if len(w) > 2]
+
+
+class Index:
+    """Скелет: обработчики с шаблонами путей, рёбра для обхода, unit'ы модулей."""
+
+    def __init__(self, sk):
+        self.sk = sk; N = self.N = sk["nodes"]
+        self.handlers = []; seen = set()
+        for nid, n in N.items():
+            if n["kind"] != "method":
+                continue
+            mp = ann_paths(n.get("annotations"))
+            if not mp:
+                continue
+            owner_anns = N[n["owner"]].get("annotations") or []
+            cls_ann = ann_paths(owner_anns)
+            if not cls_ann and any(a["name"].rsplit(".", 1)[-1] in _SPRING_MAPPINGS for a in owner_anns):
+                continue
+            cls_paths = list(dict.fromkeys(p for _, ps in cls_ann for p in ps)) or [""]
+            cls_verbs = {v for v, _ in cls_ann if v and v != "REQUEST"}
+            for verb, vals in mp:
+                if verb == "REQUEST":
+                    verbs = sorted(cls_verbs) or [None]
+                elif cls_verbs:
+                    verbs = sorted(cls_verbs | {verb})
+                else:
+                    verbs = [verb]
+                for hv in verbs:
+                    for v in vals:
+                        for cp in cls_paths:
+                            segs = path_segs(cp + "/" + v); key = (nid, hv, tuple(segs))
+                            if key not in seen:
+                                seen.add(key); self.handlers.append((nid, hv, segs))
+        self.cs_method = {nid: n["method"] for nid, n in N.items() if n["kind"] == "call_site"}
+        self.calls = collections.defaultdict(set); self.over = collections.defaultdict(set)
+        self.wiring = collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(set))
+        for e in sk["edges"]:
+            if e["type"] == "calls":
+                self.calls[self.cs_method[e["source"]]].add(e["target"])
+            elif e["type"] == "overrides":
+                self.over[e["target"]].add(e["source"])
+            elif e["type"] in ("remote_call", "message_delivery", "runtime_dispatch", "data_access"):
+                self.wiring[e["type"]][self.cs_method.get(e["source"], e["source"])].add(e["target"])
+        self.module = {nid: n["module"] for nid, n in N.items() if n["kind"] == "method"}
+        self.units = {n["name"]: set(n.get("deployment_units") or [n["name"]]) for n in N.values() if n["kind"] == "module"}
+        self.size = collections.Counter(u for us in self.units.values() for u in us)
+        self.stmts = collections.defaultdict(list)
+        for e in sk["edges"]:
+            if e["type"] == "contains" and e["target"].startswith("stmt:"):
+                self.stmts[e["source"]].append(e["target"])
+
+    def unit_of(self, m):
+        """Самый узкий unit модуля метода: отдельный сервис при нескольких вариантах сборки."""
+        mod = self.module[m]
+        return min(self.units.get(mod, {mod}), key=lambda u: (self.size[u], u))
+
+    def cha(self, m):
+        out, st = set(), [m]
+        while st:
+            x = st.pop()
+            for o in self.over.get(x, ()):
+                if o not in out:
+                    out.add(o); st.append(o)
+        return out
+
+    def handlers_for(self, method, path, host=None):
+        """Обработчики, чей шаблон совпадает с путём запроса (host — сервис, если проект без gateway)."""
+        segs = path_segs(path); matches = []
+        for nid, verb, tpl in self.handlers:
+            if host and host not in self.N[nid]["module"]:
+                continue
+            if (verb is None or method is None or verb == method or (method == "HEAD" and verb == "GET")) and match(segs, tpl):
+                matches.append((nid, verb, tpl))
+        return self.preferred_handlers(matches, method)
+
+    def preferred_handlers(self, candidates, method=None):
+        """Compare paths within each service and known HTTP method."""
+        best, output = {}, collections.defaultdict(set)
+        for nid, verb, template in candidates:
+            group = (self.N[nid]['module'], verb if method is None else method)
+            priority = (*path_priority(template), bool(method and verb == method))
+            if group not in best or priority > best[group]:
+                best[group], output[group] = priority, {nid}
+            elif priority == best[group]:
+                output[group].add(nid)
+        return set().union(*output.values()) if output else set()
+
+    def handler_docs(self):
+        """Текст обработчика для лексического поиска: шаблон пути (x3), имя (x2), модуль."""
+        docs = {}
+        for nid, verb, tpl in self.handlers:
+            docs.setdefault(nid, []).extend(toks(" ".join(tpl)) * 3 + toks(self.N[nid]["name"]) * 2 + toks(self.N[nid]["module"]))
+        return docs
+
+    def closure(self, entries):
+        """Обход в контексте unit'а: вызовы — только в модули того же unit'а (общие модули могут входить в несколько сервисов);
+        remote — переход в unit обработчика. -> (методы, calls, remote, data)."""
+        seen, edges, remote, data = set(), set(), set(), set()
+        st = [(m, self.unit_of(m)) for m in entries]
+        while st:
+            m, u = st.pop()
+            if (m, u) in seen:
+                continue
+            seen.add((m, u))
+            for t in self.calls.get(m, ()):
+                for x in ({t} | self.cha(t) | self.wiring["runtime_dispatch"].get(m, set())):
+                    if not self.N[x].get("abstract") and u in self.units.get(self.module.get(x), ()):
+                        edges.add((m, x)); st.append((x, u))
+            for t in self.wiring["remote_call"].get(m, set()) | self.wiring["message_delivery"].get(m, set()):
+                remote.add((m, t)); st.append((t, self.unit_of(t)))
+            for t in self.wiring["data_access"].get(m, set()):
+                data.add((m, t))
+        return {m for m, _ in seen}, edges, remote, data
+
+
+
+class BM25:
+    def __init__(self, docs, k1=1.2, b=0.75):
+        self.ids = list(docs); D = [docs[i] for i in self.ids]
+        self.tf = [collections.Counter(d) for d in D]; self.len = [len(d) for d in D]
+        self.avg = sum(self.len) / max(1, len(D)); self.k1, self.b = k1, b
+        df = collections.Counter(t for c in self.tf for t in c)
+        self.idf = {t: math.log(1 + (len(D) - n + 0.5) / (n + 0.5)) for t, n in df.items()}
+
+    def rank(self, q):
+        """-> [(балл, id)] по убыванию, только ненулевые."""
+        q = collections.Counter(q); sc = []
+        for i, tf in enumerate(self.tf):
+            s = 0.0
+            for t, qn in q.items():
+                if t in tf:
+                    s += self.idf[t] * tf[t] * (self.k1 + 1) / (tf[t] + self.k1 * (1 - self.b + self.b * self.len[i] / self.avg)) * min(qn, 3)
+            if s > 0:
+                sc.append((s, self.ids[i]))
+        return sorted(sc, reverse=True)

+"""Source-file discovery, token normalization and route-prefix matching."""
+import os
+import re
+from baseline_closure import toks
+
+FRONT_EXT = ('.js', '.html', '.htm', '.vue', '.ts', '.jsx', '.tsx')
+SKIP_DIR = {'node_modules', 'target', 'build', 'dist', '.git', 'bower_components'}
+VENDOR = re.compile(r'(\.min\.|^(vue|angular|jquery|bootstrap|echarts|amazeui|iscroll|cropper|aliyun|react|lodash|moment|d3|three)\b)', re.I)
+VOWELS = set('aeiouy')
+
+def stem(w):
+    """Консервативная нормализация английских суффиксов без предметного словаря."""
+    if len(w) >= 5 and w.endswith("ies"):
+        return w[:-3] + "y"
+    if len(w) >= 5 and w.endswith("es") and w[-3] in "sxz" or w.endswith(("ches", "shes")):
+        w = w[:-2]
+    elif len(w) >= 4 and w.endswith("s") and not w.endswith(("ss", "us", "is")):
+        w = w[:-1]
+    for suf in ("ing", "ed"):
+        if w.endswith(suf) and len(w) - len(suf) >= 4 and any(c in VOWELS for c in w[:-len(suf)]):
+            w = w[:-len(suf)]
+            if len(w) > 4 and w[-1] == w[-2] and w[-1] not in VOWELS:
+                w = w[:-1]
+            break
+    return w
+
+
+def ntoks(t):
+    return [stem(w) for w in toks(t)]
+
+
+def prefix_match(segs, tpl):
+    """Литерал пути из фронтенда против шаблона обработчика: литерал может обрываться перед хвостом из переменных
+    (`"/items/" + itemKey`)."""
+    i = 0
+    for i, s in enumerate(segs):
+        if i >= len(tpl):
+            return False
+        t = tpl[i]
+        if t == "**":
+            return True
+        if not (t.startswith("{") or t == "*" or t == s):
+            return False
+    return all(t.startswith("{") or t in ("*", "**") for t in tpl[len(segs):])
+
+
+def front_files(root):
+    for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(root):
+        dns[:] = [d for d in dns if d not in SKIP_DIR and not d.startswith(".")]
+        for f in fns:
+            if f.endswith(FRONT_EXT) and not VENDOR.search(f):
+                p = os.path.join(dp, f)
+                if os.path.getsize(p) < 400_000:
+                    yield p
+

+"""Reproducible microprojects: changed domains, stateful requests and REST/data wiring."""
+import argparse
+from copy import deepcopy
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'tests'))
+from builders import build, INVENTORY, LIBRARY
+from analyzer.__main__ import analyze, serial
+from analyzer.contracts import ContractGrounder, ContractIndex
+from analyzer.frontend import Frontend
+from analyzer.project import Project
+from analyzer.state import Database
+
+
+def run(project, database, scenario):
+    frontend = Frontend(project)
+    block, report = analyze(project, frontend, ContractIndex(project, frontend), None, database,
+                            {'facts': {}, 'unresolved': []}, scenario, grounder_type=ContractGrounder)
+    return block, report
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--directory', type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    results = []
+    for name, sources, actions, rows in [
+        ('inventory', INVENTORY, ['Reserve key "r4" with enabled true', 'Reserve key "r5" with enabled false'], {'reservations': []}),
+        ('library', LIBRARY, ['Add book key "b2" title "Second"', 'Lookup book key "b2"', 'Lookup book key "absent"'], {'books': []}),
+    ]:
+        project, database, ids = build(args.directory / 'fixtures' / name, sources, module=name, rows=rows)
+        scenario = {'id': 'independent-' + name, 'steps': [{'n': i + 1, 'action': action} for i, action in enumerate(actions)]}
+        before = deepcopy(database.tables)
+        block, report = run(project, database, scenario)
+        alternatives = [s['alternatives'][0] for s in report['steps']]
+        assert database.tables == before
+        if name == 'inventory':
+            assert alternatives[0]['entry'] == ids['StockController.reserve']
+            assert alternatives[0]['parameters'] == {'key': 'r4', 'enabled': True}
+            assert alternatives[1]['parameters'] == {'key': 'r5', 'enabled': False}
+            assert alternatives[0]['result']['key'] == 'r4'
+            assert alternatives[1]['result'] is None
+            assert alternatives[1]['state_after']['database_rows']['inventory.reservations'] == 1
+        else:
+            assert [a['entry'] for a in alternatives] == [ids['BookController.add'], ids['BookController.lookup'], ids['BookController.lookup']]
+            assert alternatives[1]['result'] == 'Second'
+            assert alternatives[2]['result'] == 'absent'
+        renamed = deepcopy(scenario)
+        renamed['id'] = 'another-arbitrary-name'
+        other, _ = run(project, database, renamed)
+        def normalize(answer):
+            return {('scenario' if e['relation'] == 'executes' else e['source'], e['relation'], e['target']) for e in answer['edges']}
+        assert normalize(block) == normalize(other)
+        results.append({'project': name, 'passed': True, 'scenario': scenario, 'answer': block, 'report': report})
+
+    # Two independently indexed services, merged into the supplied skeleton schema.
+    sources = {
+        'shop': {'Shop.java': '''@RestController class Shop {
+          RestTemplate http;
+          @PostMapping("/orders") Receipt place(@RequestBody Request input) {
+            return http.postForObject("http://ledger/charges", new HttpEntity(new Charge(input.sku)), Receipt.class);
+          }
+        }
+        class Request { String sku; }
+        class Receipt { String key; }
+        class Charge { String key; Charge(String key) { this.key = key; } }'''},
+        'ledger': {'Ledger.java': '''@RestController class Ledger {
+          Store repository;
+          @PostMapping("/charges") Charge charge(@RequestBody Charge input) { repository.save(input); return input; }
+          @GetMapping("/charges/{key}") Charge lookup(@PathVariable String key) { return repository.findByKey(key); }
+        }
+        @Entity @Table(name="charges") class Charge { @Id String key; }
+        interface Store extends JpaRepository<Charge,String> { Charge save(Charge item); Charge findByKey(String key); }'''}
+    }
+    root = args.directory / 'fixtures' / 'remote'
+    merged = {'project': 'fixture', 'nodes': {}, 'edges': [], 'context': {}}
+    dump = []
+    for module, files in sources.items():
+        _, _, _ids = build(root / module, files, module=module, rows={'charges': []} if module == 'ledger' else {})
+        skeleton = json.loads((root / module / 'skeleton.json').read_text())
+        for node in skeleton['nodes'].values():
+            if node.get('file'):
+                node['file'] = module + '/' + node['file']
+            for origin in node.get('origin', []):
+                if origin.get('file'):
+                    origin['file'] = module + '/' + origin['file']
+        merged['nodes'].update(skeleton['nodes'])
+        merged['edges'].extend(skeleton['edges'])
+        dump.append((root / module / 'initial.sql').read_text())
+    (root / 'skeleton.json').write_text(json.dumps(merged))
+    (root / 'initial.sql').write_text('\n'.join(dump))
+    project, database = Project(root / 'skeleton.json', root), Database(root / 'initial.sql')
+    scenario = {'id': 'independent-remote', 'steps': [
+        {'n': 1, 'action': 'Place order sku "item-7"'}, {'n': 2, 'action': 'Lookup charge key "item-7"'}]}
+    block, report = run(project, database, scenario)
+    assert any(e['relation'] == 'remote' and e['source'].startswith('method:shop:')
+               and e['target'].startswith('method:ledger:') for e in block['edges'])
+    assert any(e['relation'] == 'data' and e['target'] == 'res:table:ledger.charges' for e in block['edges'])
+    assert report['steps'][1]['alternatives'][0]['result']['key'] == 'item-7'
+    results.append({'project': 'remote', 'passed': True, 'scenario': scenario, 'answer': block, 'report': report})
+    path = args.directory / 'generalization.json'
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'independent microprojects, not evidence of general repository support',
+                                'results': results}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=serial) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'projects': [r['project'] for r in results]}))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Run inference with Python audit hooks blocking network and reference inputs."""
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+written_outputs = set()
+audit_stats = {'blocked_network': 0, 'blocked_processes': 0, 'blocked_reference_reads': 0, 'python_file_reads': 0}
+
+
+def audit(event, args):
+    if event in ('socket.connect', 'socket.getaddrinfo', 'subprocess.Popen', 'os.system'):
+        audit_stats['blocked_network' if event.startswith('socket.') else 'blocked_processes'] += 1
+        raise PermissionError('Offline inference blocked: ' + event)
+    if event == 'open' and isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes)):
+        path, mode, _ = args
+        reading = not isinstance(mode, str) or not any(c in mode for c in 'wax')
+        if not reading:
+            written_outputs.add(str(Path(path).resolve()))
+        else:
+            audit_stats['python_file_reads'] += 1
+        parts = Path(path).parts
+        if reading and (any(p in ('gold', 'runs', 'sample', 'benchmark') for p in parts)
+                        or Path(path).name in ('submission.json', 'solution.zip')) and str(Path(path).resolve()) not in written_outputs:
+            audit_stats['blocked_reference_reads'] += 1
+            raise PermissionError('Reference/previous-answer input blocked: ' + str(path))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    from analyzer.portable import main
+    sys.addaudithook(audit)
+    try:
+        main()
+    finally:
+        import json
+        if '--report' in sys.argv:
+            report_path = Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--report') + 1])
+            report_path.with_name(report_path.stem + '-offline-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit_stats, indent=2) + '\n')

+"""Package a checked variant without virtual environments, caches or model weights."""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import zipfile
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open('rb') as stream:
+        for data in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
+            h.update(data)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def main():
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    answer = json.loads((root / 'submission.json').read_text())
+    report = json.loads((root / 'benchmark/analysis-report.json').read_text())
+    evaluation = json.loads((root / 'benchmark/evaluation.json').read_text())
+    format_check = json.loads((root / 'benchmark/format_check.json').read_text())
+    if (not answer['scenarios'] or format_check['status'] != 'format_only'
+            or not report.get('run_complete') or set(answer['scenarios']) != set(report['requested_scenarios'])):
+        raise ValueError('Answer or saved format verification is missing')
+    manifest = {'solution': int(re.search(r'Решение № (\d+)', (root / 'README.md').read_text())[1]),
+                'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                'site_score': None, 'local_score': evaluation['score'],
+                'submission_sha256': digest(root / 'submission.json'),
+                'seconds': report['elapsed_seconds'], 'peak_rss_bytes': report['peak_rss_bytes'],
+                'analysis_status': {sid: r['analysis_status'] for sid, r in report['scenarios'].items()},
+                'code_sha256': {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): digest(p)
+                                for p in sorted((root / 'code').rglob('*')) if p.is_file()
+                                and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}}
+    (root / 'benchmark/run.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
+    paths = [p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()
+             and not any(part in ('.venv', '__pycache__', '.pytest_cache', 'cache') for part in p.relative_to(root).parts)
+             and p.name not in ('.DS_Store', 'solution.zip', 'archive-check.json')
+             and not p.name.startswith('reproduction-')]
+    archive = root / 'solution.zip'
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipped:
+        for path in sorted(paths):
+            zipped.write(path, path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zipped:
+        if zipped.testzip() is not None or zipped.read('submission.json') != (root / 'submission.json').read_bytes():
+            raise ValueError('Archive integrity check failed')
+        check = {'sha256': digest(archive), 'bytes': archive.stat().st_size,
+                 'files': len(zipped.namelist()), 'root_submission_matches': True, 'testzip': 'passed'}
+    (root / 'benchmark/archive-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(check, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps(check, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
